1938年7月8日。晨间译件。

(8) 7月7日上午8时20分，慕尔鸣路（Moulmein Road）。
(9) 7月7日上午8时50分，极司菲尔公园（Jessfield Park）。
(10) 7月7日上午11时10分，福州路靠近虞洽卿路处。
(11) 7月7日下午1时40分。传单从一辆经过龙门路附近爱德华七世大道的公交车上分发。
传单种类各异，由不同组织印发。在所有这些传单中，以下五种最为重要：
1) 呼吁本地中国居民惩治汉奸的传单。
2) 赞扬中国空军力量并呼吁居民向政府捐献黄金以购买飞机的传单。
3) 赞扬国民政府财政部控制外汇，因其对抗战期间中国财政有益，并建议居民全力协助政府的传单。
4) 宣布中国统一，并驳斥关于各派系之间发生争端或某位政府高官与另一位不和的报道的传单，称这些报道系某一方或汉奸捏造。
5) 敦促资本家开发内地的传单。

昨日下午4时至7时之间，在南京路发现了爱国小册子。下午4时30分，几种传单从南京路先施公司前的一辆2路电车上抛出。四名乘客因涉嫌抛撒传单被警察逮捕。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

便衣日本人进行搜查

昨晚9时许，约30名便衣日本人出现在爱德华七世大道与金神路（Kingse Road）转角处，并对行人进行搜查。得知此事后，因担心可能导致租界内发生骚乱，一队苏格兰士兵携两辆装甲车立即被派往现场维持秩序。当日本人看到英军到来时，便朝外滩方向离去，英军及其装甲车紧随其后。
晚上10时许，日本宪兵在河南路搜查行人。

《新闻摘要》：

昨日下午5时许，约30名便衣日本人在四川路及其附近搜查行人。工部局警务处得知此事后，派遣英军乘装甲车前往该地。便衣日本人随后朝外滩方向离开。
昨晚10时后，一大群武装日本宪兵在河南路与爱德华七世大道转角处搜查行人。公共租界当局立即派遣英军乘三辆装甲车前往该地维持和平与秩序。双方对峙，局势一度危急。晚上11时，日本宪兵撤离。

July 8, 1938. Morning Translation.

Morning Leader :-

At 9 p.m. yesterday, two Japanese military
trucks, fully laden with gendarmes, drove into Avenue
Edward VII from The Bund. The trucks stopped at the
corner of Kiangse Road where the gendarmes alighted and
started to search pedestrians. A passing French Police
van stopped and kept a watch. The trucks proceeded slowly
westward, followed by the French van. In the vicinity of
Lungmen Road, the trucks again stopped. They left at
11.50 p.m.

Morning Leader and other local newspapers :-

Police Arrest Some 300 Suspects

In addition to patrolling the streets, the
Shanghai Municipal Police yesterday afternoon despatched
a number of riot vans to hotels and large tea shops
including the Tsing Lien Koh (青蓮閣), Ih Loh Tien
(一樂天) and Loo Tsung Koh (鹿苑閣) to carry out
searches. More than 300 suspects were arrested. They
will be released this morning if they can find reliable
guarantors.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao and other local newspapers :-

Youth Found in Possession of Hand Grenade

Yesterday being the anniversary of the
Sino-Japanese hostilities, strict precautionary measures
were maintained by the French Police.
At about 5 a.m. yesterday a suspicious looking
youth named Kiang (江), of about 20 years of age, native
of Nanking, appeared at the corner of Rue Hue and Rue du
Consulet. When he was searched a hand grenade was found
on his person. He was taken to the French Police Station
for enquiries.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao and other local newspapers :-

French Police Break Up Gathering of Students

Information was received by the French Police
authorities at about 11 a.m. yesterday to the effect that a
number of young students were assembling on the 3rd floor
of the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de Montigny. A party
of detectives and plain clothes police officers were
immediately rushed to the place and took 49 persons to the
Police Station. They were all released at 6 p.m. when it
was learned that they had assembled at the place simply
to join a vegetable-diet-group.

1938年7月8日。晨间译稿。

《晨报》（Morning Leader）：

昨晚9时，两辆满载宪兵的日军军用卡车从外滩驶入爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）。卡车在江西路转角处停下，宪兵下车并开始搜查行人。一辆路过的法国警车停下并进行监视。卡车缓慢向西行驶，法国警车紧随其后。在龙门路附近，卡车再次停下。它们于晚上11时50分离开。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：

警方逮捕约300名嫌疑人

上海公共租界工部局警务处昨日下午除巡逻街道外，还派遣多辆防暴车前往青蓮閣、一樂天及鹿苑閣等旅馆和大型茶楼进行搜查。共逮捕嫌疑人300余名。若他们能找到可靠的担保人，将于今早释放。

《华美晨报》（Hwa Mei Chen Pao）及其他本地报纸：

青年被发现持有手榴弹

昨日正值中日敌对行动周年纪念日，法国警察保持了严格的预防措施。
昨晨约5时，一名姓江（Kiang）、约20岁、南京籍的可疑青年出现在胡埃路（Rue Hue）与领事馆路（Rue du Consulet）的转角处。经搜身，在其身上发现一枚手榴弹。他被带往法国警察局接受讯问。

《华美晨报》及其他本地报纸：

法国警察驱散学生集会

法国警察当局于昨日上午11时许接到情报，称有一批年轻学生正在蒙蒂尼大道（Boulevard de Montigny）基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）三楼集会。一队侦探和便衣警察立即赶赴现场，将49人带至警察局。后得知他们聚集于此仅是为了加入一个素食团体，遂于下午6时将所有人释放。

pages.en:
July 7, 1938.
Morning Translation

Morning Leader, Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

ANNIVERSARY OF SINO-JAPANESE HOSTILITIES

As a mark of respect for the soldiers and civilians who have died in the hostilities, the various circles in Shanghai will observe July 7, the first anniversary of the war of resistance, by flying the national flag, observing a vegetarian diet and ceasing all social entertainments. A 3-minute silence will be observed at noon.
General Chiang Kai-shek will broadcast a speech at 8 p.m. to-day from the Central Broadcasting Station. The speech will be translated into English by Madame Chiang Kai-shek. The wave lengths of the station are: long wave K.C. 1010 and short wave K.C. 9250. Local residents who have receiving sets may listen in to the broadcast.

Circular Telegram Issued By Local Bodies

The following circular telegram has been issued by the people's bodies in Shanghai :-
"To the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, the National Government, the Provincial and Hsien Governments, Public Bodies and People throughout the country, c/o the Central News Agency :
"One year has elapsed since the Japanese bandits invaded China. Thanks to the able leadership of General Chiang Kai-shek, the wise direction of the military commanders, the bravery of our officers and men and the loyalty of the people, we have succeeded in dealing a severe blow to the plans of the Japanese bandits for a quick decision. We have also succeeded in bringing about a unification of the country and in winning the sympathy of the world; consequently, we are confident of final victory.
"On this the first anniversary of the war of resistance, all fellow-countrymen should realize that to submit now is tantamount to satisfying one's thirst with poison. The only way out is to fight. Besides observing the measures drawn up by the National Government to commemorate the anniversary, we should swear to live or die with the country and to do our utmost for the country so long as we remain alive."

News Digest :-

Various Circles of Shanghai Address Circular to Chinese Residents in Shanghai

Brethren throughout Shanghai,
To-day is the first anniversary of China's war of resistance. The plans of the enemy for a quick war have been shattered. This is due to the consolidation of the united front of the Chinese people and the bravery of the officers and men at the front. The enemy is encountering immense difficulties. Our final victory is approaching. In addition to commemorating the memory of those officers and men who have fallen at the front, we must enthusiastically take part in the following work to ensure final victory :-

1938年7月7日。
晨间译稿

《晨报》、《大美报》（Ta Mei Pao）及其他本地报纸：

中日敌对行动周年纪念日

为纪念在敌对行动中牺牲的军民，上海各界将于7月7日——抗战一周年纪念日——悬挂国旗、实行素食并停止一切社交娱乐活动。中午将默哀三分钟。
蒋介石将军将于今晚8时在中央广播电台发表广播讲话。该讲话将由蒋夫人翻译成英语。该电台波长为：长波 K.C. 1010 和短波 K.C. 9250。拥有接收机的本地居民可收听广播。

本地团体发布的通电信

上海各人民团体发布了如下通电信：
“致中央党部、国民政府、各省县政府、公共团体及全国同胞，由中央通讯社转交：
‘自日寇侵华至今已一年。得益于蒋介石将军的英明领导、军事指挥官的正确指挥、我军官兵的英勇以及民众的忠诚，我们成功重创了日寇速战速决的计划。我们还实现了国家的统一，赢得了世界的同情；因此，我们对最终胜利充满信心。
’值此抗战一周年之际，全体同胞应认识到，此时屈服无异于饮鸩止渴。唯一的出路是战斗。除了遵守国民政府制定的纪念周年措施外，我们应宣誓与国家共存亡，只要活着就为国家竭尽全力。’”

新闻摘要：

上海各界向在沪华人发布通告

上海全体同胞：
今日是中国抗战一周年纪念日。敌人速战速决的计划已被粉碎。这归功于中国人民统一战线的巩固以及前线官兵的英勇。敌人正面临巨大困难。我们的最终胜利即将来临。除了纪念在前线阵亡的官兵外，我们必须热情参与以下工作，以确保最终胜利：

pages.en:
July 7, 1938. Morning Translation.

1) To exercise economy and contribute money to the
government

The war of resistance means the general
mobilization of the man-power and resources of the
entire people. The Government has to purchase firearms,
pay wages to the officers and men at the front and in
the rear, issue compassionate grants to the families of
those wounded or killed and render relief to refugees.
Money is required. Not only should we offer our savings
to the Government, but we should also economize our
daily expenses and offer our savings to the Government.
Extravagant expenditure must be regulated. To-day
is the anniversary of the Lukouchiao Incident and the
anniversary of the outbreak of local hostilities on
August 13 is approaching. Brethren throughout Shanghai
should start a movement to offer money to the Government
during these 40 days and commemorate the August 13
War with this movement.

2) To support the government in the stabilization of its
financial policy

The war of resistance has been going on for
a year, but our financial position is still very strong.
The Government is instituting a control of foreign
exchange for the purpose of stabilizing the legal tender
notes. It is our duty to support this policy. We
must cease speculating in foreign exchange. Look at
the Jews who are without a country. How miserable are
their living conditions in Germany?

3) To oppose all peace movements and to deal with traitors
and pro-Japanese elements

After the great wastage in the past year, the
enemy is showing signs of weakening. In order to avert
a war of long duration and to get a chance to rest, the
enemy is conspiring with traitorous elements and pro-
Japanese undesirables to start a peace movement. These
shameless elements are using Hongkong and Shanghai as
their bases of activities. We should deal with such
bad elements that are in hiding in Shanghai.

Brethren! The enemy is in a dangerous position.
Let us be more determined to carry on the war of resistance.

Open Letter from Student Circles

"Schoolmates! We have been struggling for
one year for the emancipation and freedom of our fatherland.
Let us relate to you our experience of the past year. The
collective strength of our unity will conquer everything.
Our efforts at national salvation will bring about unity.
"The whole military situation has now become
a war for the defence of the Wuhan. In Shanghai our
enemy with the assistance of Chinese traitors are preparing
pages.zh:
1938年7月7日。晨间译稿。

1) 厉行节约并向政府捐款

抗战意味着全民人力和资源的总动员。政府需要购买枪械，支付前线及后方官兵的薪饷，向伤亡者家属发放抚恤金，并向难民提供救济。这需要资金。我们不仅应将储蓄献给政府，还应节省日常开支，将省下的钱献给政府。必须规范奢侈支出。今日是卢沟桥事变周年纪念日，而八一三局部敌对行动爆发周年纪念日也即将到来。上海全体同胞应在这40天内发起向政府捐款运动，并以这一运动来纪念八一三战争。

2) 支持政府稳定金融政策

抗战已持续一年，但我们的财政状况依然非常强劲。政府正在实施外汇管制，以稳定法币。支持这一政策是我们的责任。我们必须停止外汇投机。看看那些没有国家的犹太人。他们在德国的生活条件多么悲惨？

3) 反对一切和平运动，惩治汉奸及亲日分子

经过过去一年的巨大消耗，敌人显示出 weakening（减弱）的迹象。为了避免长期战争并获得喘息之机，敌人正与汉奸分子及亲日不良分子勾结，发起和平运动。这些无耻之徒以上海和香港为活动基地。我们应处置隐藏在上海的这些坏分子。

同胞们！敌人处于危险境地。让我们更加坚定地继续抗战。

学生界公开信

“同学们！我们为祖国的解放和自由奋斗了一年。让我们向你们讲述过去一年的经历。我们团结的集体力量将战胜一切。我们的救国努力将带来统一。
“目前的整个军事局势已转变为保卫武汉之战。在上海，我们的敌人在中国汉奸的协助下正准备

pages.en:
July 7, 1938. Morning Translation.

a heavy attack. We wish to ask: Have students in
Shanghai formed themselves into a strong body? Are we
confident that we can defeat our enemy? General Chiang
Kai-shek will be able to defend Wuhan for at least six
months. Are we strong enough to support General Chiang
and to meet the requirements of our Government? We are
not, because we have not yet succeeded in unifying our
schoolmates and establishing a united Students' body.
"Therefore, we earnestly call upon all
schoolmates in Shanghai to unite. Let us organize our-
selves under the one purpose of offering resistance to
Japan. Let us immediately form an anti-Japanese battle
front because without this we cannot accomplish our
national salvation work neither can we extend our anti-
Japanese and anti-traitor work. If we, as Chinese
citizens, are unable to undertake these two tasks, it shall
be our life-long shame. While the cries of 'Long live
the victory of China's war of res.' are resounding
throughout the country, what have we to offer to accelerate
this glorious day? We earnestly call on all of you to
make up your minds and to extend our unity and to intensify
our anti-Japanese and anti-traitor work.
"Let us shout:-
"Let all the students throughout Shanghai
be united!
"Support the Government and the war of
resistance!
"Struggle to the bitter end for final victory
in the war of resistance!
"Long live the emancipation of the Chinese
race!"
pages.zh:
1938年7月7日。晨间译稿。

发动猛烈攻击。我们要问：上海的学生是否已组成一个强有力的团体？我们有信心击败敌人吗？蒋介石将军将能够保卫武汉至少六个月。我们是否有足够的力量支持蒋将军并满足政府的要求？我们没有，因为我们尚未成功团结同学并建立统一的学生团体。
“因此，我们恳切呼吁上海全体同学团结起来。让我们在抗日这一共同目标下组织起来。让我们立即组建抗日战线，因为如果没有这一点，我们既无法完成救国工作，也无法扩展我们的反日和反汉奸工作。如果我们作为中国公民无法承担这两项任务，这将是我们终身的耻辱。当‘中国抗战胜利万岁’的呼声回荡在全国各地时，我们要拿出什么来加速这一光荣日子的到来？我们恳切呼吁大家下定决心，扩大我们的团结，加强我们的反日和反汉奸工作。
“让我们高呼：
“让上海全体学生团结起来！
“支持政府和抗战！
“为抗战的最终胜利奋斗到底！
“中华民族解放万岁！”

pages.en:
July 6, 1938. Morning Translation

Ta Mei Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE ANNIVERSARY OF THE LUKOUCHIAO INCIDENT ON JULY 7

On the outbreak of the Lukouchiao incident on
July 7 last year, General Chiang Kai-shek declared that
China had reached the final stage of sacrifice. He
resolutely decided on a war of resistance.
A year has now elapsed. Although the Chinese
soldiers have not yet succeeded in driving the enemy from
the country, they have caused Japan severe losses in men
and money. The war of resistance has entered the third
stage but we are growing stronger and stronger and final
victory will be ours. The National Government has named
July 7 as the Anniversary of the War of Resistance and has
decreed that henceforth this day will be commemorated
every year.

Local Observance

At a joint meeting held yesterday by
various public bodies in Shanghai, it was resolved :-
(1) That flags be hoisted in commemoration
of the event and all public bodies and schools hold
services in memory of the fallen soldiers and civilians.
(2) That all amusements be suspended.
(3) That a circular be issued calling on the
people in Shanghai to observe a 3-minute silence at noon
July 7 wherever they may be.
(4) That a circular be issued calling on the
people in Shanghai to go on a vegetable diet on that day
and to contribute the money thus saved to charitable
organs for the relief of refugees.
(5) That the following manifesto be issued :-
July 7 is the first anniversary of the
commencement of China's war of resistance. Several
millions of officers and men have participated in the
fighting. The dream of the enemy robbers to put
a speedy end to the fighting has been shattered. The
400,000,000 Chinese are rendering every assistance in
the work of saving the country. The ruin of the enemy
robbers is approaching.
The war of resistance and the construction of
the nation are two very heavy tasks, but we must not
relax our efforts. The following are some of the urgent
matters which should be attended to :-
At the outbreak of the Lukouchiao Incident,
our supreme leader at once announced a war of long
duration to waste the strength of the enemy. Final
victory will ensure the integrity of our territory and
the sanctity of our sovereign rights. We are not worrying
over local defeats, but we should worry if we cannot
continue the war for a long time. The loss of a city
does not mean anything. During the past year, China has
lost territory equal in area to ten provinces, but the
enemy robbers have wasted their resources which they had
accumulated for one hundred years and some 500,000 of
their officers and soldiers have either been killed or
wounded. About 1,000,000 Chinese mobile units are
scattered in occupied areas, and the enemy robbers are
pages.zh:
1938年7月6日。晨间译稿

《大美报》及其他本地报纸：

7月7日卢沟桥事变周年纪念日

去年7月7日卢沟桥事变爆发时，蒋介石将军宣布中国已达到牺牲的最后阶段。他坚决决定进行抗战。
如今一年已过。虽然中国军队尚未成功将敌人驱逐出境，但他们给日本造成了严重的人员和金钱损失。抗战已进入第三阶段，但我们正越来越强大，最终胜利必将属于我们。国民政府已将7月7日定为抗战周年纪念日，并规定此后每年均要纪念此日。

本地纪念活动

在上海各公共团体昨日举行的联席会议上，决议如下：
(1) 悬挂旗帜以纪念此事，各公共团体和学校举行仪式纪念阵亡将士及平民。
(2) 暂停一切娱乐活动。
(3) 发布通告，呼吁上海民众在7月7日中午无论身在何处，均默哀三分钟。
(4) 发布通告，呼吁上海民众在该日实行素食，并将由此节省的钱款捐给慈善机构以救济难民。
(5) 发布如下宣言：
7月7日是中国抗战开始的一周年纪念日。数百万官兵参与了战斗。敌寇速战速决的梦想已被粉碎。四亿中国人正在为救国工作提供一切援助。敌寇的覆灭即将来临。
抗战与国家建设是两项非常艰巨的任务，但我们绝不能松懈努力。以下是一些亟待处理的事项：
卢沟桥事变爆发时，我们的最高领袖立即宣布进行持久战以消耗敌人的力量。最终胜利将确保我们领土的完整和主权的尊严。我们不为局部的失败而担忧，但如果我们不能长期坚持战争，则应担忧。失去一座城市并不意味着什么。在过去一年中，中国失去了相当于十个省面积的领土，但敌寇浪费了其积累百年的资源，其约50万名官兵阵亡或受伤。约100万中国机动部队散布在被占领区，敌寇正

pages.en:
July 6, 1938. Morning Translation.

experiencing great difficulty to keep open the railway
zones and highways. If the enemy robbers desire to occupy
Wuhan, it will take them at least six months and at a
tremendous cost in men and money. The enemy robbers will
become weak even if they win the war, but they will be
ruined if they lose. China is confident of victory and
the people in Shanghai should fully realize this.
Shanghai became isolated following the withdrawal
of the Chinese forces, but the feeling of the Chinese
people in this city to resist the enemy has never waned.
The shooting of traitors and undesirables on the streets,
the resistance offered by the Chinese employees of the
Shanghai Customs, the refusal of Chinese radio stations
to register and the flying of the national flag on
anniversaries--- all this shows that the Chinese in Shanghai
are prepared to fight the enemy to the bitter end. However,
a small section of local Chinese residents are still
indulging in pleasures. This is an insult to the Chinese
people. Our brethren should exercise economy and
contribute towards the relief of refugees.
The Chinese troops withdrew from Hsuchow after
holding it for six months. At Taierchwang, they achieved
a great victory. Our 3,000,000 brethren in Shanghai
should intensify the work for the suppression of traitors.
pages.zh:
1938年7月6日。晨间译件。

在维持铁路沿线区域和公路畅通方面正面临巨大困难。如果敌寇想要占领武汉，他们至少需要六个月的时间，并将付出巨大的人力和财力代价。敌寇即使赢得战争也会变得虚弱，但如果战败则将彻底崩溃。中国对胜利充满信心，上海民众应充分认识到这一点。
随着中国军队的撤离，上海陷入孤立，但本市中国人民的抗敌情绪从未减弱。街头枪杀汉奸和不良分子、海关中国职员的抵抗、中国广播电台拒绝登记以及在纪念日悬挂国旗——所有这些都表明上海的中国人准备与敌人战斗到底。然而，一小部分当地中国居民仍然沉溺于享乐。这是对中国人民的侮辱。我们的同胞应当厉行节约，并为救济难民做出贡献。
中国军队在坚守徐州六个月后撤离。在台儿庄，他们取得了重大胜利。我们在上海的三百万同胞应加强肃清汉奸的工作。

pages.en:
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :- /H 7

FIRST ANNIVERSARY OF THE LUKOUCHIAO INCIDENT

July 7 will be the first anniversary
of the Lukouchiao Incident. Local universities, middle
schools and primary schools will hoist the national flag
on that day and will stand quietly at noon as a mark of
respect to the Government. The people will place themselves
on a vegetable diet on that day in respect of the memory
of the Chinese officers and men who have fallen in the
battlefield as well as for all Chinese civilians killed
during the hostilities. Money saved by the vegetable diet
should be contributed towards the upkeep and the education
of refugee children and should be handed to the Sin Hua
Bank ( 華 ) on Avenue Joffre, French Concession.

Strict Precautionary Measures to be Adopted in the Foreign
Settlements

Chinese residents in the local Foreign
Settlements will hoist the national flag at half mast on
July 7, the first anniversary of the Sino-Japanese
hostilities. It is rumoured that a certain party will
take the opportunity to stage demonstrations.
For fear of incidents, the authorities
of the two Foreign Settlements will adopt strict
precautionary measures on July 7.
pages.zh:
《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：- /H 7

卢沟桥事变一周年

7月7日将是卢沟桥事变的一周年纪念日。本地大学、中学和小学将在当天悬挂国旗，并在中午静立默哀，以示对政府的敬意。人们将在当天素食，以纪念在战场上阵亡的中国官兵以及在敌对行动期间遇难的所有中国平民。通过素食省下的钱款应捐赠用于难民儿童的抚养和教育，并交至法租界霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）的新华银行（Sin Hua Bank）。

在外国租界采取严格的预防措施

本地外国租界内的中国居民将于7月7日，即中日敌对行动一周年纪念日，降半旗致哀。有谣言称，某一方将利用这个机会举行示威活动。
出于对发生事端的担忧，两个外国租界的当局将于7月7日采取严格的预防措施。

He was regarded as a patriot when he

January 28 incident. Actually, however, his patriotism

Ta Kung Pao dated July 3 and other local newspapers
published the following letter from Hankow :-

ANNIVERSARY OF LUKOUCHIAO INCIDENT

Upon the outbreak of the Lukouchiao incident
on July 7 last year, Chiang Kai-shek, the supreme
command of the Chinese military authorities, decided
that the limit of Chinese endurance and sacrifices
had been reached and the time for China to start a
resistance to bring about national reconstruction and
for the defence of the country had arrived. He therefore
resolved to take up arms to meet our strong neighbour
on the battle ground.

Now the first anniversary of the incident
is approaching; although the Chinese armies have not
yet succeeded in driving away the enemy from Chinese
soil, they have caused many serious setbacks, both
financial and military, to the Japanese.

China's military strength and national
spirit have become stronger and more determined than
ever. The National Government has set July 7 this year
as the anniversary of the Chinese resistance for national
reconstruction. The Public Affairs Department of the
Central Publicity Committee has drawn up a set of
measures governing propaganda of the first anniversary
of the Chinese resistance. It has also decided to hold
memorial services on this date every year to demonstrate
the strong determination of the Chinese resistance.

The propaganda measures drawn up by the
Central Publicity Committee of the National Government
contain the following slogans:-

"July 7 is the anniversary for national
reconstruction."
"Soldiers and people unite in one body to
carry on the resistance to the bitter end."
"March along the bloody path set by our
heroes."
"Avenge our dead."
"Remove the population to facilitate the
defence of Greater Hankow."
"Down with the Japanese Imperialists."
"Long live the resistance for national
reconstruction."
"Long live the Republic of China."
"Long live the Chinese Kuomintang."
"Long live the leader of the Chinese Government
and people."

1938年7月4日。午后译件。

当他**〔此处转录不清〕**汉奸胡立夫（Hu Lih-fu）**〔此处转录不清〕**“一·二八”事变时，他被视为爱国者。然而实际上，他的爱国只是表面文章，因为其目的是赢取10,000美元的赏金。在去年8月敌对行动爆发时，他继续参与各种爱国政治团体的活动，但现在他已担任上海特别市警察局侦缉队外勤股股长一职。

7月3日的《大公报》及其他本地报纸刊登了来自汉口的以下信件：-

卢沟桥事变周年纪念日

去年7月7日卢沟桥事变爆发时，中国军事最高统帅蒋介石决定，中国忍耐和牺牲的极限已经达到，中国开始抵抗以实现国家重建和保卫国家的时刻已经到来。因此，他决心拿起武器，在战场上迎击我们强大的邻国。

现在，事变的一周年纪念日即将来临；虽然中国军队尚未成功将敌人赶出中国领土，但他们给日本造成了许多严重的挫折，无论是在财政上还是军事上。

中国的军事力量和民族精神变得比以往任何时候都更加强大和坚定。国民政府已将今年的7月7日定为中国抗战建国纪念日。中央宣传部公共事务处制定了一套关于中国抗战一周年宣传的措施。还决定每年在此日期举行纪念仪式，以展示中国抗战的坚定决心。

国民政府中央宣传部制定的宣传措施包含以下口号：-

“七七是抗战建国纪念日。”
“军民团结一心，坚持抗战到底。”
“沿着英雄们的血路前进。”
“为死者报仇。”
“疏散人口以利于大武汉的防卫。”
“打倒日本帝国主义者。”
“抗战建国万岁。”
“中华民国万岁。”
“中国国民党万岁。”
“中国政府和人民领袖万岁。”

Local Organs
Send Appeal
To Roosevelt

U.S. Gov't Asked To
Stop Handing Over
Of Chinese

MESSAGE SIGNED BY
15 ORGANIZATIONS

Council's Action Said
Contrary To Humanity,
Treaties

A telegram to President Franklin
D. Rooseve! urging the United
States Government to prevent the
Shanghai Municipal Council from
handing over young Chinese patriots
to the Japanese Army has been
sent by a group of 15 local civic or-
ganizations, THE CHINA PRESS learn-
ed yesterday.

Organizations signing the telegram
included the Shanghai Chinese
Ratepayers' Association, which re-
cently lodged a protest with the
Council on the matter and a Sino-
foreign body which has as it mem-
bers foreigners of many nationali-
ties, including several Americans.

The telegram and the signatures
were submitted to United States
Consul-General Frank P. Lockhart
for transmission to Washington.

The text of the telegram states:
"Supporting Chinese Govern-
ment's protest, we urge American
Government which is signatory to
the Land Regulations take im-
mediate action prevent Shanghai
Municipal Council illegally handing
over to Japanese army for certain
execution young Chinese patriots
arrested, here held without trial,
charged terrorist acts against dis-
loyal Chinese. Council's action
contrary accepted concepts justice,
humanity as well as treaty regula-
tions governing recognized civil
courts International Settlement."
pages.zh:
本地机构
发出呼吁
给罗斯福

要求美国政府
停止移交
中国人

由15个组织
签署的信函

称工部局的行动
违背人道主义
及条约

据《字林西报》（THE CHINA PRESS）昨日获悉，一个由15个本地公民组织组成的团体向富兰克林·D·罗斯福总统发送了一份电报，敦促美国政府阻止上海工部局将年轻的中国爱国者移交给日本军队。

签署电报的组织包括上海华人纳税会，该会最近就此事向工部局提出抗议，还有一个中外联合机构，其成员包括多国国籍的外国人，其中包括几名美国人。

电报及签名已提交给美国总领事弗兰克·P·洛克哈特（Frank P. Lockhart），以便转送至华盛顿。

电报全文如下：
“支持中国政府的抗议，我们敦促作为《土地章程》签署国的美国政府立即采取行动，防止上海工部局非法将被捕的、未经审判而被指控对不忠中国人实施恐怖行为的年轻中国爱国者移交给日本军队处以极刑。工部局的行动违背了公认的正义和人道主义观念，以及管辖国际租界公认民事法院的条约规定。”

pages.en:
August 9, 1938. Morning Translation.

To Mei Iao and other local newspapers:

15 CHINESE PUBLIC BODIES IN SHANGHAI SEND TELEGRAM
TO PRESIDENT ROOSEVELT ASKING HIM TO PREVENT THE
HANDING OVER OF CHINESE TO JAPANESE MILITARY AUTHORITIES

According to information secured late last
night from a reliable foreign source, 15 Chinese public
bodies in Shanghai, including the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association in the International Settlement, on August 8
sent an urgent telegram to President Roosevelt through
the American Consul-General in Shanghai. Recently the
Chinese Ratepayers' Association in the International
Settlement sent a protest to the S.M.C. against the handing
over of a patriotic Chinese youth to the Japanese
authorities.

The gist of the telegram reads as follows :-
"The American Government is urged to lose no time in
adopting effective measures to prevent the S.M.C. from
handing over patriotic Chinese youths to the Japanese
authorities for execution, because the American Government
is one of the signatories of the Yangkingpang Land
Regulations. Such action on the part of the Council
constitutes a violation of justice, humanity and Court
regulations."

致《美亚》（Mei Iao）及其他本地报纸：

上海15个中国公共团体致电罗斯福总统，请求他阻止将中国人移交给日本军事当局

根据昨晚从可靠的外国来源获得的消息，上海15个中国公共团体，包括国际租界华人纳税会，于8月8日通过美国驻上海总领事馆向罗斯福总统发送了一份紧急电报。最近，国际租界华人纳税会就向日本当局移交一名中国爱国青年一事向上海工部局（S.M.C.）提出抗议。

电报大意如下：-
“敦促美国政府不失时机地采取有效措施，防止上海工部局（S.M.C.）将中国爱国青年移交给日本当局处以极刑，因为美国政府是《洋泾浜土地章程》的签署国之一。工部局的此类行为构成了对正义、人道主义和法院规定的违反。”

pages.en:
WH.Misc.283/38.

C O P Y

C.8 Special Branch.
July 28, 1938.

Further to Bombs thrown into Japanese controlled area,
North Thibet and Alabaster Roads.

The suspect Nyi Ah Mei (倪阿美) was brought before
the Shanghai Special District Court during the forenoon
of 15.7.38 and at the request of the police he was ordered
to be released.

The gown found at the scene with the bicycle were order-
ed to be detained at the Police Station.

As there was no direct evidence to show that Nyi Ah Mei
was other than a victim of circumstances, he was allowed to
go after having produced a substantial guarantor, and since
that date he has accompanied detectives attached to this
section around various roads, etc in the French Concession
where information may have been obtained concering the where-
abouts of the man Zung (张).

On the 7.7.38 one named Kiang Hai Chu (江海珠) alias
Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂生) was arrested by a French Police
search party on the corner of Rje du Consulat and Rue Hue,
French Concession. At time of his arrest he was found to be
in possession of a bomb, subsequent enquiries revealing that
he had carried same from the International Settlement, in
view of which he was handed over to Crime Branch Headquarters
C.8. on that date.

The man after a lengthy interrogation admitted being
a member of a gang of political assassins and gave the names
of two men named Zung Kai Kwang (张开光) and Zung Kai Yuen
(张开元).
pages.zh:
WH.Misc.283/38.

副本

C.8 特别分部。
1938年7月28日。

关于向北西藏路（North Thibet Road）和阿拉巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）的日本控制区投掷炸弹的后续情况。

嫌疑人倪阿美（Nyi Ah Mei）于1938年7月15日上午被带至上海特区法院，应警方要求，他被命令释放。

在现场与自行车一起发现的大衣被命令扣押在警察局。

由于没有直接证据表明倪阿美不仅仅是环境的受害者，他在提供了一名有力的担保人后被允许离开，自那以后，他一直陪同隶属于本分部的侦探在法租界的各条道路等地四处走访，那里可能获得了关于张（Zung）姓男子下落的信息。

1938年7月7日，一名名叫江海珠（Kiang Hai Chu），又名江桂生（Kiang Kwei Sung）的男子在法租界领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）和 Hue 路街角被法国警察搜查队逮捕。被捕时，发现他持有一枚炸弹，随后的调查显示他是从国际租界携带该炸弹至此，鉴于此，他于当天被移交给 C.8 罪案组总部。

经过长时间审讯，该男子承认自己是政治刺客团伙的成员，并供出了两名男子的名字，分别是张开光（Zung Kai Kwang）和张开元（Zung Kai Yuen）。

pages.en:
- 2 -

As it was suspected that the persons referred to as
Zung might be the person wanted in connection with the
offence, Nyi Ah Mei was recalled to this office and when
confronted with the prisoner Kiang Hai Chu he immediately
identified him as an association of the man known to him
as Zung.

Kiang Hai Chu then admitted that this bombing had
been done by two persons namedly Zung Kai Yuen and Wong
Kwang Zai at the instigation of one named Sung Yah Shing
(孙亚生), leader of the group.

Endeavours to arrest any of these men proved fruitless
and on the 25/7/38 Kiang Hai Chu was handed over to the
Japanese Military Authorities as per regulations laid down
in S.M.C. Emergency Proclamation dated 19th July, 1938.
For full particulars of this man's statement, etc. see C.I.
Misc. Report No.108/38 Crime Branch Headquarters.

On the 22nd July 1938 a male Chinese named Zung Kai
Kwang was arrested whilst escaping from the scene of the
Assassination of Zung Yueh Poo on Jessfield Road (See F.I.R.
1584/38 B'Well). This man was subsequently handed over to
Crime Branch Headquarters C.8, and as a result of interrogation
admitted that his brother age 16 years named Zung Kai Yuen
accompanied by Wong Kwang Zai (黄光才) and that the instigator
was one named Sung Yah Shing, leader of the group. In view
of this the man Nyi Ah Mei was again called to station and
immediately identified this man as the brother of the man
Zung to whom he referred in making his statement to the
Police on the 7th July 1938.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

由于怀疑被称为张（Zung）的人可能与该罪行有关而被通缉，倪阿美被召回本办公室，当让他与囚犯江海珠对质时，他立即指认江海珠是他所知的张姓男子的同伙。

江海珠随后承认，这次爆炸是由张开元和黄光才（Wong Kwang Zai）两人实施的，受该团伙头目孙亚生（Sung Yah Shing）的唆使。

逮捕这些人的任何努力均无果而终，1938年7月25日，根据1938年7月19日上海工部局紧急公告的规定，江海珠被移交给日本军事当局。关于此人供述等的详细情况，参见 C.I. Misc. Report No.108/38 罪案组总部报告。

1938年7月22日，一名名叫张开光（Zung Kai Kwang）的中国男子在极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）张月浦（Zung Yueh Poo）遇刺案现场逃跑时被逮捕（参见 F.I.R. 1584/38 B'Well）。该男子随后被移交给 C.8 罪案组总部，经审讯后承认，他16岁的弟弟张开元在黄光才（Wong Kwang Zai）的陪同下参与了行动，唆使者是该团伙头目孙亚生。鉴于此，倪阿美再次被叫到警局，并立即指认该男子就是他在1938年7月7日向警方陈述时提到的张姓男子的兄弟。

pages.en:
- 3 -

The accused Zung Kai Kwang as a result of further
questioning gave information that led to the arrest of fourteen
male and one female Chinese also the seizure of three pistols
and ammunition. Amongst these arrests was Sung Yah Shing,
leader of this group, and he when questioned admitted being
the instigator of this offen-ce, but denied knowing the
whereabouts of either Zung Kai Yuen or Wong Kwan Zai who are
still at large. For full particulars of the latter's state-
ment see F.I.R. 1584/38 B'well.

In conclusion I would mention that Nyi Ah Mei is in no
way implicated in this case, and rather appears to have been
a victim of circumstances. In addition he has rendered the
Police every assistance in trying to round up these persons
and is till doing so.
pages.zh:
- 3 -

被告张开光在经过进一步讯问后，提供了导致逮捕14名中国男性和1名中国女性以及缴获三支手枪和弹药的信息。在这些被捕人员中包括该团伙头目孙亚生，他在受审时承认是此次犯罪的唆使者，但否认知道仍在逃的张开元或黄光才的下落。关于后者供述的详细情况，参见 F.I.R. 1584/38 B'well。

最后我要提到，倪阿美与此案毫无牵连，反而似乎只是环境的受害者。此外，他在试图围捕这些人方面向警方提供了所有协助，并且至今仍在这样做。

5.9718
21 7 38

Terrorist Is
Handed Over
To Japanese

First Case Carried Out
Under New Emergency
Proclamation

ARRESTED WITH BOMB
IN CONCESSION

Homicide Squad Delving
Into Operations Of
Terrorist Leaders

A precedent was set yesterday, in accordance with the recently released Emergency Proclamation by the Shanghai Municipal Council, when an alleged terrorist was handed over to the Japanese authorities in Hongkew, after having been in custody of the Homicide Squad of the S.M.P., for a period of several days.

The man handed over to the Japanese authorities, was actually arrested in the French Concession on July 7, last, when he was found in possession of a hand-grenade. He was one of the few men arrested on the eventful July 7, against whom any tangible evidence could be obtained.

He was handed over to the Homicide Squad of the S.M.C., for questioning in connection with the various assassinations and bombing outrages, and yesterday morning the S.M.P. officials decided that there was sufficient evidence to hand him over to the Japanese authorities. Any of the other 23 suspects, including three women, at present in custody of the Homicide Squad, are liable to be handed over to the Japanese if refused sanctuary of the Settlement and thereby liable to expulsion.

No sensational revelations have been made by the Homicide Squad since Saturday, when they took into custody the alleged instigator of three assassinations, including the attempt on the life of Mr. Yue Cong-sung, wealthy cotton broker and Chairman of the Shanghai Civic Association, on Jinkee Road outside the Cathay Hotel at noon on June 10.

Full Investigation

A thorough questioning of all the suspects in custody is being continued by a staff of five foreign and many Chinese detectives. Main attention is being paid to the alleged instigator of the assassinations and the two young assassins who were arrested immediately after the killing of Mr. Van Chi-sen, veteran Chinese legal practitioner and supporter of the Ta Tao Government, at his home on Sinza Road on Thursday morning, and the killer of Mr. Dzang Yuen-poo, of the Japanese Censorship Bureau on Jessfield Road on Friday morning.

Under the Emergency Proclamation issued by the Council on July 18, not only terrorists, but also persons aiding terrorists or found in possession of firearms and ammunition, are liable to be expelled from the International Settlement.

01891
5.9718
21 7 38

恐怖分子被
移交给日本人

根据新颁布的紧急公告
执行的首起案件

在租界内
携炸弹被捕

凶杀组深入调查
恐怖分子头目的活动

昨日，上海公共租界工部局根据最近发布的《紧急公告》，开创了一个先例：一名涉嫌恐怖分子在被工部局警务处（S.M.P.）凶杀组羁押数日后，被移交给虹口的日本当局。

这名被移交给日本当局的人，实际上是在去年7月7日于法租界被捕的，当时发现他持有一枚手榴弹。他是那个多事之秋7月7日被捕的少数几人中，能够获取任何确凿证据的对象之一。

他被移交给工部局（S.M.C.）凶杀组，就各种暗杀和爆炸暴行接受讯问。昨天上午，工部局警务处官员决定有足够证据将其移交给日本当局。目前由凶杀组羁押的其他23名嫌疑人（包括三名女性），如果被拒绝在租界内避难并因此面临驱逐，也可能被移交给日本方面。

自上周六以来，凶杀组未做出任何轰动性的披露。上周六，他们羁押了一名涉嫌策划三起暗杀案的主谋，其中包括6月10日中午在静安寺路（Jinkee Road）华懋公寓（Cathay Hotel）外对富有的棉花经纪人、上海市民协会主席岳从松（Yue Cong-sung，音译）先生进行的未遂刺杀。

全面调查

由五名外籍侦探和多名华籍侦探组成的小组正在继续对所有在押嫌疑人进行彻底讯问。主要关注点是涉嫌策划暗杀的主谋，以及两名年轻刺客：一人在周四上午于新闸路（Sinza Road）家中杀害资深中国法律从业者、大陶政府支持者范志森（Van Chi-sen，音译）先生后立即被捕；另一人在周五上午于极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）杀害日本审查局的张元普（Dzang Yuen-poo，音译）先生。

根据工部局于7月18日发布的《紧急公告》，不仅是恐怖分子，协助恐怖分子或被发现持有枪支弹药的人员，也 liable to be expelled from the International Settlement（可能被逐出国际租界）。

（批：5 1/2）
（批：file 16/7）
（批：C 26/7）

C.8, Crime Branch. 3597
July 22, 26 38. / .38

Arrest of bomb thrower by French Police on July 7, 1938.

// and D.S.I. Crighton

Sir,

On the 10/7/38 this case was handed over to Crime
Branch Headquarters C.8 for further investigation.

Daily since above date the accused Kiang Hai Chu
(江海秋), alias Kiang Hai Sung (江海生), alias Kiang
Ming Kwei (江明鬼), has been subject to lengthy
interrogation and as a result a detailed statement has
now been obtained from him (copy attached).

In order to corroborate this statement detectives
（批：DC. Sp/Brnach Information Crighton 2.5.）led by this accused visited the following addresses.-
1.You Fah (海发) Lodging House, Rue Palikao, French
Concession, was visited at 9.30 a.m. on the 19/7/38
and as a result of enquiries therein it was definitely
established that accused had along with two others
engaged this room on the morning of May 2nd and had left
on the May 3rd, 1938.
2.Keong Vee (公和) Lodging House, Rue de Siccawei,
French Concession, was visited at 10.15 a.m. 19/7/38
and as a result it was confirmed that accused had along
with two others occupied Room No.1 between the morning
of May 3rd and morning of May 6th, 1938.
3.Tuh Shing (德兴) Lodging House, Boulevard de Montigny,
French Concession, was visited at 10.45 a.m. 19/7/38
and there it was confirmed that accused had occupied
room No.13 between May 6th and May 8th, 1938.
4.Pah Sien (八仙) Lodging House, Boulevard de Montigny,
French Concession, was visited at 11.15 a.m. 19/7/38,
and it was confirmed that accused had occupied Room
No.37 between May 8th and 14th, 1938.
pages.zh:
办公室
C.1, 杂项
108/38.
C.8, 刑事科. 3597
1938年7月22日 / .38

1938年7月7日法国警察逮捕投掷炸弹者。

// 及副督察长（D.S.I.）克莱顿（Crighton）

先生，

本案于1938年7月10日移交至刑事科总部C.8进行进一步调查。

自上述日期以来，被告江海秋（Kiang Hai Chu），又名江海生（Kiang Hai Sung），又名江明鬼（Kiang Ming Kwei），每天都接受长时间讯问，结果现已从他那里获得一份详细供词（副本附后）。

为了证实这份供词，由该被告带领的侦探
（批：DC. Sp/Brnach Information Crighton 2.5.）走访了以下地址：-
1. 海发（You Fah）客栈，位于法租界贝勒路（Rue Palikao），于1938年7月19日上午9:30走访，经查询确证，被告曾与另外两人于5月2日上午租用此房间，并于1938年5月3日离开。
2. 公和（Keong Vee）客栈，位于法租界徐家汇路（Rue de Siccawei），于1938年7月19日上午10:15走访，经确认，被告曾与另外两人在1938年5月3日上午至5月6日上午期间占用1号房间。
3. 德兴（Tuh Shing）客栈，位于法租界蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny），于1938年7月19日上午10:45走访，经确认，被告在1938年5月6日至8日期间占用13号房间。
4. 八仙（Pah Sien）客栈，位于法租界蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny），于1938年7月19日上午11:15走访，经确认，被告在1938年5月8日至14日期间占用37号房间。

pages.en:
- 2 -

The accused next led detectives to the Zung An Li
(仁安里) Alleyway, Rue Wagner, French Concession, where
he stated he had occupied a room above the alleyway rented
to them through Zau Liang (趙良) who had previously
lived at this address. One named Zung Ah Nyi (陳阿二),
a private watchman employed in this alleyway was confronted
with the accused and immediately identified him as one of
the many persons who used to occupy and frequent the room
above the alleyway. The watchman further added that his
eldest son Zung Hai Kwan (陳開光), alias Zung Yuen Liang
(陳源良), was a friend of this man, but that recently
his son, whom he considered a black sheep had left this
address and had not returned home. At this stage of the
investigation it was discovered that it was this watchman
who had guaranteed one named Nyi Ah Mi (倪阿米) to the
bicycle shop at 235 Route Kraetzer, French Concession,
in connection with the bomb throwing case at Alabaster Road
on July 7, 1938 (for full particulars see Misc. report No.
283/38 W.H.). In view of this the man Nyi Ah Mi who had
previously been arrested by West Hongkew and held on a
writ of detention was confronted with this man and immediately
identified him as an associate of the man he knew as Zung
(陳). On the other hand the accused identified Nyi
Ah Mi as a person whom he had met through the introduction
of Zung Hai Kwan (陳開光), but denied that he (Nyi Ah Mi)
was in any way connected with the assassination group.
pages.zh:
- 2 -

随后，被告带领侦探前往法租界华格纳路（Rue Wagner）的仁安里（Zung An Li）弄堂，他说他曾通过此前居住在此处的赵良（Zau Liang）租用了弄堂上方的一个房间。一名名叫陈阿二（Zung Ah Nyi，音译）的私人巡夜人被带来与被告对质，该巡夜人受雇于该弄堂，他立即指认被告是曾经占用并频繁出入弄堂上方房间的多人之一。该巡夜人还补充说，他的长子陈开光（Zung Hai Kwan），又名陈源良（Zung Yuen Liang），是此人的朋友，但最近他认为这个败家子儿子已离开此处，尚未回家。在调查的这一阶段，发现正是这名巡夜人为倪阿米（Nyi Ah Mi，音译）向法租界克勒策尔路（Route Kraetzer）235号的自行车店作了担保，此事与1938年7月7日在阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）发生的投掷炸弹案有关（详情参见杂项报告第283/38 W.H.号）。鉴于此，此前被西虹口警署逮捕并凭拘留令关押的倪阿米被带来与此人对质，并立即指认他是其所认识的陈某（Zung）的同伙。另一方面，被告指认倪阿米是他通过陈开光（Zung Hai Kwan）介绍认识的人，但否认倪阿米与暗杀团体有任何关联。

pages.en:
- 3 -

The accused next led detectives to the Chung Nan
Hotel, Avenue Edward VII, where it was again confirmed
that he along with several others had occupied room 329
on the night of the 6th July 1938.

Since his arrest by the French Police this man has
divulged several addresses wherein his accomplices may
have been located but without result.

In further corroboration of the accused's statement
wherein he makes mention of the Yiu Chueh Sung (尤菊蓀)
attempted assassination on June 10, 1938, (see F. I. R.
No 1400/38 Central), the prisoner Tseu Ying (周英), alias
Tseu Vee Yeong (周維榮) was removed from cells and taken
to the offices of C. S, where without hesitation he identified
the accused as Kiang Hai Chu whilst the latter did likewise
in identifying him as Tseu Ying.

In view of this man's statement and as there is no
doubt in the mind of the undersigned as to his guilt, I
suggest that he be dealt with in accordance with the S. M. C.
Emergency Proclamation dated 12/7/38.

John Coughlan
D. S.

D. C. (Crime)

Copy to D. C. (Special Branch)
French Police

（左侧手写批注：）
DSS 71
- x - See also -
D 7994/1; 28571
pages.zh:
- 3 -

随后，被告带领侦探前往爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的中南酒店（Chung Nan Hotel），再次确认他与其他几人曾在1938年7月6日晚占用329号房间。

自从被法国警察逮捕以来，此人透露了几个可能藏有其同伙的地址，但均无结果。

为了进一步证实被告关于提及1938年6月10日尤菊蓀（Yiu Chueh Sung）未遂暗杀案的供词（参见中央分局第一调查报告第1400/38号），囚犯周英（Tseu Ying），又名周维荣（Tseu Vee Yeong），被从牢房提出并带至刑事科（C. S.）办公室，他毫不犹豫地指认被告为江海秋，而后者也同样指认他为周英。

鉴于此人的供词，且签署人对其罪行毫无疑问，我建议根据1938年7月12日的工部局《紧急公告》对其进行处理。

约翰·考夫兰（John Coughlan）
副督察长（D. S.）

刑事科副督察长（D. C. (Crime)）

抄送：特别处副督察长（D. C. (Special Branch)）
法国警察

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂生)
Chinkiang                                D.S.I. Crighton
Police Hdqrs.        14/7/38             D.S.I.Liao Chung-chien

My name is Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂生), alias Kiang Hai
Chiu (江海秋), alias Kiang Ming Kwei (江明貴). I was
born in the city of Nanking on the 26th. day of September,
1918. My parents were of the middle class, my father being
employed as a shop-assistant in a piece goods store in Chin-
kiang. When I was seven years old my mother brought me to
Shanghai, where we resided with a friend of my father's named
Tsu Tah Ziang (左大祥), at the corner of East Yuhang and
Singkeepang Roads. I remained in Shanghai until I attained
the age of 13 years. During these six years I neither went
to school nor did I do any form of work whatever. Leaving
Shanghai at this time, I returned to Chinkiang with my mother
and thence to Nanking where I entered Yang Tsung (養正)
Primary School, remaining therein until I was 19 years of age.
On leaving this school, I again returned to Shanghai in the
company of my mother and again took up residence at the home
of Tsu Tah Ziang (左大祥). Later I joined the Shanghai
Middle School, situated at the Small South Gate, Nantao, as
a boarding student. This would be in March 1936 and I remained
therein, studying Chinese literature until the end of June
1937 when owing to the tense situation prevailing in Shanghai
the school closed down and I returned to live at the home
of Tsu Tah Ziang at the corner of East Yuhang and Singkeepang
Roads.

During my stay at this school I did not take part in any
political movements, nor did I ever hear any political doctrines
being taught therein. The day upon which I left this school
pages.zh:
江桂生（Kiang Kwei Sung）
镇江                                副督察长（D.S.I.）克莱顿（Crighton）
警察总局        1938年7月14日             副督察长（D.S.I.）廖仲坚（Liao Chung-chien，音译）

我叫江桂生（Kiang Kwei Sung），又名江海秋（Kiang Hai Chiu），又名江明贵（Kiang Ming Kwei）。我于1918年9月26日出生在南京城。我的父母属于中产阶级，父亲在镇江一家布店担任店员。我七岁时，母亲带我来到上海，我们与我父亲的朋友左大祥（Tsu Tah Ziang）同住，地址在余杭东路与辛家棚路（Singkeepang Roads，音译）转角处。我在上海一直住到13岁。在这六年里，我既没上学，也没做任何工作。当时我离开上海，随母亲回到镇江，随后又去南京，进入养正（Yang Tsung）小学读书，一直读到19岁。离开这所学校后，我再次随母亲回到上海，再次住在左大祥家中。后来，我作为寄宿生加入了位于南市小南门的上海中学。那是1936年3月，我在那里学习国文，直到1937年6月底，由于上海局势紧张，学校停课，我便回到左大祥位于余杭东路与辛家棚路转角处的家中居住。

在这所学校期间，我没有参加任何政治运动，也从未听说过那里讲授任何政治学说。我离开学校的那天

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-2-

I bought a copy of the "Central China Daily News" and on
reading same came upon an advertisement calling for members
to join the Chinese Youths' National Salvation Association,
with Headquarters at Kwan Ti Miao (關帝廟), Old West Gate,
Nantso. I considered this advertisement for the next two
days and eventually decided to join this organization. I
proceeded to the address in question and enrolled as a member,
without informing Tsu Teh Ziang or my mother, the latter, at
this time having returned to Chinkiang.

At time of visiting this temple I was interviewed by
two officers in charge of the registration of members whom
I subsequently found out were named Sung Yah Sing (宋亞興)
and Van Tih Tsiao (范鐵焦). The former at this time handed
me a form which was more or less an examination paper calling
upon me to voice my opinion regarding the then tense situation
and also requesting to known in which particular section of
the Association I wished to join.

In voicing my opinion I made mention of the fact that I
was in agreement with the principle that all Chinese youths
should participate in the movement against the invasion of
China by Japan and there and then I pledged myself to assist
in the first aid or red cross corps formed by that organisa-
tion. This was on or about the 30th. June, 1938.

On the early morning of the latter date I proceeded to
Kwan Ti Miao, Old West Gate, Nantso, and on arrival there
saw a gathering of some 500 male youths, ages variant from
15 to 30 years of the student and shop-assistant type.

（左侧批注：x: See also:-
D8597 8571
D 8635 D1994/）
pages.zh:
江桂生

-2-

我买了一份《华中日报》，阅读时看到一则招募成员加入“中国青年救国会”的广告，总部设在南市老西门的关帝庙（Kwan Ti Miao）。我考虑了两天这则广告，最终决定加入该组织。我前往该地址登记成为会员，没有通知左德祥（Tsu Teh Ziang，音译，前文为左大祥）或我的母亲，此时母亲已返回镇江。

在访问该庙时，两名负责成员登记的官员对我进行了面谈，我后来得知他们名叫宋亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）和范铁焦（Van Tih Tsiao，音译）。前者当时递给我一张表格，大致是一份考卷，要求我就当时的紧张局势发表意见，并询问我希望加入协会的哪个具体部门。

在发表意见时，我提到我同意所有中国青年都应参与抵抗日本侵华运动的原则，并当场宣誓协助该组织成立的急救或红十字会队伍。这大约是在1938年6月30日。

在该日清晨，我前往南市老西门的关帝庙，到达那里时看到聚集了约500名男青年，年龄在15至30岁之间，多为学生和店员类型。

（左侧批注：x: 另见:-
D8597 8571
D 8635 D1994/）

pages.en:
Kiang Kwai Sung

-3-

About half an hour later a male Chinese dressed in Sun Yat-sen
uniform, who claimed to be a representative of Gen. Chang Chi-
chen (張治中), gave an instructional lecture to the gathering
urging us to exert out utmost in combating the foreign invasion
of China. In concluding his speech he appealed to the gathering
for recruits for digging trenches in and around Nanziang. Forty
persons, including myself, volunteered for this job and our
names were taken down and handed to this person, who subse-
quently left the meeting. During the next two days I remained
at the Headquarters of this organization and was given a serious
of lectures on the political situation of China by various
members, including Sung Yah Sing, Liang Tung Feng (梁桐芬),
and Zao Kong Yi (趙剛儀).

Towards the end of July 1937, we, forty volunteers,
were sent to Nansiang in charge of Sung Yah Sing and on arriv-
ing there we were drafted into the 87th. Division, which was
then occupying that area. I omitted to mention that included
in these forty recruits were Tseu Ying (周应), alias Tseu
Vee Yung (周維榮), at present under arrest for attempted
assassination of Yiu Chneh Sung (尤菊蓀), Wong Kwan Zai
(王光才), wanted in connection with that case, Doo Ta Mei
(杜大梅), alias Ching Yeung Sung, Wong Ta Koo (王子固)
and Zao Liang (趙良).

We were put to work digging trenches in and around that
locality, and remained there for a period of approximately
one month. We received no wages only food.

After hostilities had broken out on the 13th. August,
pages.zh:
江桂生

-3-

大约半小时后，一名身穿中山装的中国男子向集会人群发表了指导性演讲，声称自己是张治中将军的代表，敦促我们竭尽全力抗击外国对中国的侵略。在结束演讲时，他呼吁集会者为在南翔及其周边挖掘战壕招募人员。包括我在内的四十人自愿承担这项工作，我们的名字被记录下来并交给此人，随后他离开了会议。在接下来的两天里，我留在该组织总部，听取了包括宋亚兴、梁桐芬（Liang Tung Feng）和赵刚仪（Zao Kong Yi，音译）在内的多名成员关于中国政治局势的一系列讲座。

1937年7月底，我们四十名志愿者在宋亚兴的带领下被派往南翔，到达那里后，我们被编入当时驻扎在该地区的第87师。我漏提了一点，这四十名 recruits 中包括周应（Tseu Ying，音译，前文为周英），又名周维荣（Tseu Vee Yung），目前因企图暗杀尤菊蓀（Yiu Chneh Sung，音译）而被捕；王光才（Wong Kwan Zai），与该案有关并在被通缉；杜大梅（Doo Ta Mei），又名程仰松（Ching Yeung Sung，音译）；王子固（Wong Ta Koo）和赵良（Zao Liang）。

我们被安排在当地及其周边挖掘战壕，并在那里停留了大约一个月。我们没有工资，只提供食物。

在8月13日敌对行动爆发后，

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-4-

1937, we were not permitted to work during the day owing to frequent visits of Japanese bombing planes, hence most of our work was carried out at night.

Towards the end of August, 1938, we were informed by Sung Yah Sing (宋亞新) that owing to the association to which we belonged having been reorganized into a Special Service Corp, it would be necessary for us to return to the Tung Yah (東亞) Physical Training School, Nantso, to undergo military training. On or about the 2nd. September, 1938 we returned to the afore-said school, where daily we were taught the use of various fire-arms, bombs etc., and eventually after one month some party of us were detailed for defence duty at the Nantso Fund, under the 87th. Division Commander.

We remained in this locality until the retreat of Chinese Troops at 11 p.m. on November 11th. 1937, I and my colleagues then made for the French Concession Boundary, where at a small gate leading to Boulevard de Montiny we surrendered our arms to the French Military and were escorted to Avenue Joffre Police Station (Poste Joffre) in Motor Trucks, where we spent the night. The following morning we were again escorted in Motor Trucks to the Shanghai Law College, Route Pere Robert, where we along with a number of Nantso Police Reserves were interned.

During the confusion following our retreat I lost sight of Sung Yah Sing and did not find him at the last named place where I and others were interned.

On entering this internment camp our names etc. were
pages.zh:
江桂生

-4-

1937年，由于日本轰炸机频繁来袭，我们白天不被允许工作，因此大部分工作都在夜间进行。

1938年8月底，宋亚新（Sung Yah Sing）通知我们，由于我们所属的协会已改组为特别服务队（Special Service Corp），我们需要返回南市东亚体育学校接受军事训练。1938年9月2日左右，我们回到了上述学校，在那里每天学习使用各种枪支、炸弹等，一个月后，我们中的一部分人被派往第87师师长指挥下的南市基金处执行防卫任务。

我们一直待在该地区，直到1937年11月11日晚上11点中国军队撤退。随后我和同事们前往法租界边界，在一个通往蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard de Montiny）的小门口，我们将武器交给法国军方，并被用卡车护送到霞飞路警察局（Poste Joffre），在那里过夜。第二天早上，我们再次被用卡车护送到雷米神父路（Route Pere Robert）的上海法学院，在那里，我们与许多南市警察后备队成员一起被拘禁。

在撤退后的混乱中，我与宋亚新（Sung Yah Sing）失去了联系，在我和其他人被拘禁的最后那个地方也没有找到他。

进入这个拘禁营时，我们的姓名等

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-5-

not taken. Seven of us being aloted to each room and a
guard placed over us.

After one week in this camp, I along with six others
whose names etc. I do not knew, made good our escape by the
open window during the night. I immediately proceeded to a
Refugee Camp on Chekiang Road, but failing to gain admission
I next proceeded to Zang :ong (長康) Refugee Camp, Alabaster
Road where I was eventually admitted, I remained therein for
the next two days, and on the second day I proceeded to an
alleyway which runs along the side of the Shanghai Law College
after some difficulties I succeeded in getting into conversation
with Dee Ta Mei (杜芝梅) alias Ching Yeong Sung (金榮生). To
him I explained how I had escaped and gave him the address of
the place where I was living.

About the middle of December, 1937, Tsau Ying (周应),
alias Tsau Vee Yeong (周維榮) came to live at the Zang
Keng Refugee Camp, stating that he had been released from the
internment camp at Route Pere Robert. A few days later we
were joined by Dee Ta Mei, alias Ching Yeong Sung, Wong Kwan
Zai, See Liang, Zeu Vang Pou (趙文豹), Yuen Hung Chu (袁恒楚)
Wa Ching Sung (華全城), Tsai Koo Ying (蔡毫英), Zung Kuo
Ta (陈國土), Chiang See (蔣熙) and Yu Ah Dee (虞阿大),
all having been released from the same internment camp.

Some time later, after the fall of Nanking, which took
place on December 13th, 1937, we ten persons, wishing to
return to Hankow drafted a petition to the Jen Chi Tang
(仁濟堂) Benevolent Society on Yunnan Road requesting
pages.zh:
江桂生

-5-

并未被登记。每间房间分配给我们七个人，并有人看守。

在这个营里待了一周后，我和另外六名我不记得姓名的人，在夜间通过敞开的窗户成功逃脱。我立即前往浙江路的难民收容所，但未能获准进入，接着我前往阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road）的长康（Zang :ong）难民收容所，最终被接纳。我在那里待了接下来的两天，第二天，我前往上海法学院侧面的一条小巷，经过一番周折，我成功与杜芝梅（Dee Ta Mei），又名金荣生（Ching Yeong Sung）搭上了话。我向他解释了我如何逃脱，并给了他我的住址。

1937年12月中旬，周应（Tsau Ying），又名周维荣（Tsau Vee Yeong）来到长康难民收容所居住，声称他已从雷米神父路的拘禁营获释。几天后，杜芝梅（又名金荣生）、王克才（Wong Kwan Zai）、谢良（See Liang）、赵文豹（Zeu Vang Pou）、袁恒楚（Yuen Hung Chu）、华全城（Wa Ching Sung）、蔡毫英（Tsai Koo Ying）、陈国土（Zung Kuo Ta）、蒋熙（Chiang See）和虞阿大（Yu Ah Dee）也加入了我们，他们都是从同一个拘禁营获释的。

一段时间后，在南京于1937年12月13日沦陷后，我们十人希望返回汉口，起草了一份请愿书给云南路的仁济堂慈善机构，请求

pages.en:
Kiang Kwel Sung

-6-

them to repatriate us to that City.

One day, date forgotten another of our colleagues named
Ling Yuen Loong (林元龙) whilst enroute to the Jen Chi Tang
(仁济堂) Benevolent Society carrying our petitions, was
stopped by a search party and taken to Louza Police Station,
where this document when translated revealed that we were all
ex-members of the Special Service Corp. On ascertaining this
Louza Police Station sent a party of Police to the Zang Kong
Refugee Camp, where after having conducted an abortive search,
they took into custody myself, Tseu Ying, Zau Vung Pau(赵文新)
and Sung Pau Tu (陈国士). We were detained at Louza
Station for about three hours, during which time we were ques-
tioned by detectives regarding our duties as member of the
Special Service Corp. and eventually after we had given sa-
tisfactory explanation we were released.

In the middle of January 1938, Sung Yah Sing suddenly
called upon us at the Zang Keong Refugee Camp, how he came
to know that we were living there I do not know. He requested
all of us to proceed to Hankow to further the National Salva-
tion Movement in that City, however, when we mentioned funds
to him, he informed us that he could not assist us in this
respect but we could obtain free repatriation from local
benevolent societies. In view of this we approached the
management of the Zang Keong Refugee Camp and he advised us to
approach the Bad. Repatriation Camp, Nanking Road, for this
assistance. We did so and eventually were successful in
leaving for Hankow on or about the 5th. February, 1938.
pages.zh:
江桂生

-6-

他们将我们遣返至该城市。

有一天，日期已忘，我们的另一位同事林元龙（Ling Yuen Loong）在携带我们的请愿书前往仁济堂慈善机构的途中，被搜查队拦下并带到老闸警察局，这份文件经翻译后显示我们都是特别服务队的前成员。老闸警察局得知这一情况后，派出一队警察前往长康难民收容所，在进行了一次无果的搜查后，将我、周应、赵文新（Zau Vung Pau）和陈国士（Sung Pau Tu）拘留。我们在老闸警察局被扣留了大约三个小时，在此期间，侦探就我们作为特别服务队成员的职责对我们进行了讯问，最终在我们给出令人满意的解释后被释放。

1938年1月中旬，宋亚新突然来到长康难民收容所拜访我们，我不知道他是如何知道我们住在那里的。他要求我们所有人前往汉口，以推进那里的救国运动，然而，当我们向他提及资金问题时，他告知他在这方面无法协助我们，但我们可以从当地慈善机构获得免费遣返。鉴于此，我们联系了长康难民收容所的管理人员，他建议我们向南京路的Bad.遣返营寻求援助。我们照做了，并最终成功于1938年2月5日左右启程前往汉口。

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-7-

We first proceeded to Hongkong per s.s.Tsinan, thence
by s.s.Kwangsi to Canton. Arriving in Canton on or about
the 9-2-38, we remained there for three days, living in a
Refugee Camp. The management of this camp then arranged
Rail tickets to Hankow for us and we left Canton on the
12-2-38, arriving in Hankow on about the 15-2-38.

On arriving in Hankow we were met by Zao Kong Yi (趙剛偉)
and Sung Yah Sing (孫亞興) who had already established a
Branch office of the Chinese Youths' National Salvation
Association, to which they took us. This office was located
at 23 Sai Chi Ka (山西街), Hankow. During the ensuing two
and a half months we were engaged in spreading propaganda
on behalf of our association and attending to wounded Chinese
soldiers, in the 1st. Military Hospital, which is situated
next to our office.

Towards the end of April 1938 Zao Kong Yi (趙剛偉)
ordered the following fourteen persons, including myself, to
come to Shanghai for the purpose of assassinating traitors:-
X 1st. Sung Yah Sing (孫亞興) who was to be known as Yeu
Tsung Sung (余中人) in Shanghai, was given the position
of Officer i/c of the party.

The remaining thirteen persons were devided into four
Sections viz:-

1st. Section
Wang To Koo (王土固) No.1.
X Sun Ying (周 立) No.2.
Wong Kuen Kai (王光才) No.3.
pages.zh:
江桂生

-7-

我们先乘坐“济南”号轮船前往香港，然后换乘“广西”号轮船前往广州。我们于1938年2月9日左右抵达广州，在那里待了三天，住在难民收容所。该收容所的管理人员随后为我们安排了去汉口的火车票，我们于1938年2月12日离开广州，于1938年2月15日左右抵达汉口。

抵达汉口后，赵刚伟（Zao Kong Yi）和孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）接待了我们，他们已经建立了中国青年救国协会的分支机构，并将我们带到那里。该办事处位于汉口山西街23号。在接下来的两个半月里，我们致力于代表本协会进行宣传，并在位于我们办事处旁边的第一军用医院照料受伤的中国士兵。

1938年4月底，赵刚伟命令包括我在内的以下十四人前往上海，目的是刺杀汉奸：
X 1. 孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing），在上海将使用余中人（Yeu Tsung Sung）的名字，被任命为小队负责人。

其余十三人分为四个小组，如下：

第一组
王土固（Wang To Koo）第1号。
X 周立（Sun Ying）第2号。
王光才（Wong Kuen Kai）第3号。

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-8-

2nd. Section
X Zao Liang (趙良) No.1.
X Kiang Hai Chi (江海秋) alias
  Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂生) No.2.
X Tai Ts You (戴心裕) No.3/

3rd. Section
Tai Bing Yue (戴炳月) No.1.
Doo Ts Mei (杜竺梅) alias
Ching Yoong Sung (全榮生) No.2.
Ngai Tsung Pung (顏振邦) No.3.
Lee Tsung Hwei (李春輝) No.4.

4th. Section
X Tseu Tsung Ming (周振明) No.1.
Leo Zung Chi (呂仁釗) No.2.
Zau Sung Jau (趙松壽) No.3.

Our final instructions were to the effect that all orders
had been given to Sung Yah Sing regarding the assassination
and that he would detail any of the above four sections
to carry out these orders, which must be obeyed at all times
and above all things the utmost secrecy must be observed by
all members of this mission. He further mentioned that he
intended to come to Shanghai via Hongkong.

After receiving these instructions we were each issued
with $80.00 by Zao Kang Yi.

At approximately 7 p.m. on the 24th. day of April, 1938, we
thirteen men in the company of Sung Yah Sing boarded a
Chinese steamer, name unknown, for Kuikieng. At this time Sung
Yah Sung was carrying a leather suitcase, 3 ft. long, 2 ft.
pages.zh:
江桂生

-8-

第二组
X 赵良（Zao Liang）第1号。
X 江海秋（Kiang Hai Chi），又名
  江桂生（Kiang Kwei Sung）第2号。
X 戴心裕（Tai Ts You）第3号。

第三组
戴炳月（Tai Bing Yue）第1号。
杜竺梅（Doo Ts Mei），又名
全荣生（Ching Yoong Sung）第2号。
颜振邦（Ngai Tsung Pung）第3号。
李春辉（Lee Tsung Hwei）第4号。

第四组
X 周振明（Tseu Tsung Ming）第1号。
吕仁钊（Leo Zung Chi）第2号。
赵松寿（Zau Sung Jau）第3号。

我们的最终指示大意是，所有关于刺杀的命令都已下达给孙亚兴，他将指派上述四个小组中的任何一个来执行这些命令，必须时刻服从，最重要的是，所有执行此任务的成员必须严守秘密。他还提到他打算经由香港前来上海。

收到这些指示后，赵刚义（Zao Kang Yi）向我们每人发放了80.00美元。

1938年4月24日晚上7点左右，我们十三人在孙亚新的陪同下登上了一艘前往九江的中国轮船，船名不详。当时孙亚松（Sung Yah Sung）提着一个长3英尺、宽2英尺、

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-2-

broad, and 1ft. high. At 9 p.m. that night we left Hankow
for Kiukiang, the majority of passengers being Chinese soldiers.
The following morning at about 10 a.m. we arrived in Kiukiang
and immediately proceeded to the Railway Station where we each
purchased a ticket for Nancheng (南昌). We left Kuikiang
at about 1 p.m., arriving in Nanchang that evening we partook
of an evening meal at a restaurant near the Railway Station and
then Sung Yah Sing calling ricshas ordered us to follow him.
We all then crossed the wooden bridge over the Kan river(    ),
and arriving on the other side we immediately boarded on train
for Kingwha in the Chekiang Province. We arrived in Kingwha
at 3 p.m. the following day, and immediately took native junks
to Yu Yao, and thence to Ningpo arriving at the latter place
at noon on April 29th. 1938. On arrival, six of us, Tai Ping
Yu (戴炳之), Ngai Tsung Pang (颜振邦), Zao Liang (赵良),
Tai Ta Yu (戴祖裕), Doo Ta Mei (杜芝梅) and myself look up
residence at Room 19 Kiang Chih (江浙) Hotel, whilst the
remaining seven went to another hotel the name of which I do
not know. That night Sung Yah Sing (孙亚兴) came to our
Hotel and instructed Tai Ta You (戴祖裕), Zen Liang (赵良)
and myself to proceed to Shanghai the following day, as he
wished to send us in relays of threes thus avoiding any suspi-
cion which might arise if we all arrived at the same time. He
further instructed Zee Liang, my Section Chief, to meet him
outside the Branch Office of the Bank of China on Bubbling Well
Road at 8 a.m. on May 5th. 1938.
At 2 p.m. on April 30th. 1938, we three left Ningpo for
pages.zh:
江桂生

-2-

高1英尺的皮箱。当晚9点，我们离开汉口前往九江，乘客大多是中国士兵。第二天上午10点左右，我们抵达九江，立即前往火车站，每人购买了一张前往南昌的车票。我们于下午1点左右离开九江，当晚抵达南昌，我们在火车站附近的一家餐馆吃了晚饭，然后孙亚新叫了黄包车，命令我们跟随他。我们所有人都跨过了赣江上的木桥（    ），到达对岸后，立即登上了前往浙江省金华的火车。第二天下午3点，我们抵达金华，立即乘坐本地帆船前往余姚，然后前往宁波，于1938年4月29日中午抵达后者。抵达后，我们六人，即戴炳之（Tai Ping Yu）、颜振邦（Ngai Tsung Pang）、赵良（Zao Liang）、戴祖裕（Tai Ta Yu）、杜芝梅（Doo Ta Mei）和我，在江浙旅馆19号房间住宿，而其余七人去了另一家旅馆，名字我不知道。那天晚上，孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）来到我们的旅馆，指示戴祖裕（Tai Ta You）、赵良（Zen Liang）和我第二天前往上海，因为他希望让我们三人一组分批出发，从而避免如果我们同时到达可能引起的任何怀疑。他还指示我的组长赵良，于1938年5月5日上午8点在静安寺路中国银行分行门外与他见面。
1938年4月30日下午2点，我们三人离开宁波前往

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-10-

Shanghai by an Italian Steamer, arriving at the latter place
at 8 a.m. on May 1st. 1938, and berthing alongside the French
Bund.

On landing we proceeded to the Yuen Poh (源茂) lodging house,
situated at Rue Palikao, French Concession, where we engaged
room No.6, at $1.80 per diem. We did nothing that day, and the
following morning we removed to Kung Woo (公和) lodging house,
Rue de Siccawei, occupying room No.1, at $1.20 per diem. Our
reason for changing address was that the other was cheaper.
During the next two days we did practically nothing but loitered
around the lodging houses, however on the evening of the 6th.
May, 1938, we went out in search of a still cheaper room , and
was successful in engaging room 13 of the Tuh Shing (德興 )
lodging house, situated on Boulevard de Montigny, French Con-
cession, which we moved into at 12 noon on May 6th. 1938, later
we again moved to the Pah Shien (八仙) lodging house, Boulevard
de Montigny arriving there on May 8th. 1938.

On the morning of May 5th. 1938, Zao Liang (趙良) pro-
ceeded to outside the Bank of China Branch Office, Bubbling
Well Road and there met Sung Ya Sing (孫亞興) who after
enquiring as to our whereabouts, gave instructions that as
there was nothing to do meantime, we had better wait at the
lodging house pending his further instructions. We remained
at the Pah Shien (八仙) Lodging House from then on, and were
periodically visited by Sung Yah Sing (孫亞興).

On the 10th. May 1938, whilst I was walking on Boulevard
de Montigny, French Concession, I met Tsou Ying (周英) after
pages.zh:
江桂生

-10-

上海，乘坐一艘意大利轮船，于1938年5月1日上午8点抵达上海，停靠在法外滩旁。

上岸后，我们前往位于法租界白尔部路（Rue Palikao）的源茂（Yuen Poh）客栈，租下了6号房间，每天租金1.80美元。那天我们什么也没做，第二天早上我们搬到了徐家汇路（Rue de Siccawei）的公和（Kung Woo）客栈，住进1号房间，每天租金1.20美元。我们更换地址的原因是后者更便宜。在接下来的两天里，我们几乎什么都没做，只是在客栈周围闲逛，然而在1938年5月6日晚上，我们出去寻找更便宜的房间，并成功租下了位于法租界蒙蒂尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）的德兴（Tuh Shing）客栈13号房间，我们于1938年5月6日中午12点搬入，后来我们又搬到了蒙蒂尼路的八仙（Pah Shien）客栈，于1938年5月8日抵达那里。

1938年5月5日上午，赵良（Zao Liang）前往静安寺路中国银行分行外，在那里见到了孙亚兴（Sung Ya Sing），他在询问了我们的行踪后指示说，既然暂时没事可做，我们最好在客栈等待他的进一步指示。从那时起，我们就一直待在八仙客栈，孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）定期来访。

1938年5月10日，当我在法租界蒙蒂尼路上行走时，在黄金（Wong U..ing）剧院前遇到了周英（Tsou Ying），随后

pages.en:
Liang Kwei Sung

-11-
Tseu Voo loong (周伯榮) in front of the Wong U..ing (黃金)
Theatre, and was informed by him that he was living at Room
No.8 of the Viosen Lodging House, Rue Vioson, French Concession
along with his two colleagues Wong Kwan Zai (王克才) and
Wong Ts Koo (王志固). Two days later, I visited him at
that address, but we did not discuss any plan re our work,
merely made general conversation. Later I made two similar
calls, and on one of these visits I met Doo Is Mei (杜芝梅)
from whom I learned he was living at Sing Ming (新明) lodging
house, on Rue Agusto Boppe, along with Tai Ging Yuen (戴景元)
and Lee Tsung-hwei (李春輝).

On the 14th. May 1938, we three again changed our address
this time to a small room above the entrance to the Zung An Li
(仁安里) alleyway, Rue Wagner, French Concession. This room
was obtained by Zau Liang (趙良) who at one time used to live
in this alleyway. Whilst at this address we recruited two
new members into the group i.e. Zung Kai Kwen (陳開文) and
Zung Kai Nyou (陳開友) whose father Zung Ah Nyi (陳阿二)
was watchman of this alleyway.

About the 25th. or 26th. of May 1938, Sung Yah Sing (孫亞興)
informed Zao Liang (趙良) that he wished to take Tai Ts
You (戴祉禎) away with him as he had a job for him; we did
not know, or were we informed that nature of that job. Both
left this address and that was the last time I saw Tai Ts You
(戴祉禎). Nothing further transpired until about 1 p.m.
on June 10th. 1938, when Wong Kwan Zai (王克才) came to this
address and explained he had been sent by Sung Yah Sing (孫亞興)
pages.zh:
梁桂生

-11-
周伯荣（Tseu Voo loong）告诉我，他和他的两位同事王克才（Wong Kwan Zai）和王志固（Wong Ts Koo）住在法租界维森路（Rue Vioson）维森客栈8号房间。两天后，我去那个地址拜访了他，但我们没有讨论任何关于工作的计划，只是进行了泛泛的交谈。后来我又进行了两次类似的拜访，在其中一次拜访中，我遇到了杜芝梅（Doo Is Mei），从他那里我得知他与戴景元（Tai Ging Yuen）和李春辉（Lee Tsung-hwei）一起住在奥古斯特·博佩路（Rue Agusto Boppe）的新明（Sing Ming）客栈。

1938年5月14日，我们三人再次更换地址，这次搬到了法租界华格纳路（Rue Wagner）仁安里（Zung An Li）弄堂入口上方的一间小房间。这间房间是由赵良（Zau Liang）找到的，他曾经住在这个弄堂里。在这个地址期间，我们招募了两名新成员加入小组，即陈开文（Zung Kai Kwen）和陈开友（Zung Kai Nyou），他们的父亲陈阿二（Zung Ah Nyi）是该弄堂的看门人。

1938年5月25日或26日左右，孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）通知赵良（Zao Liang），他想带走戴祉禎（Tai Ts You），因为他有一份工作给他；我们不知道，也没有被告知那份工作的性质。两人离开了这个地址，那是最后一次见到戴祉禎。此后直到1938年6月10日下午1点左右，没有发生其他事情，当时王克才（Wong Kwan Zai）来到这个地址，解释说他是孙亚兴（孫亞興）派来的

pages.en:
Kiang Kwai Sung

-12-

He further explained that, that morning he had been involved i
the assassination of one named Yih Chweh Sung (尤新松), a
traitor, on Jinkee Road, and that his two colleagues Tsou
Ying (周应) and Tai Ts You had been surrounded and to his
knowledge arrested by Settlement Police. That night we read
in the newspaper that Tai Ts You (戴祖裕) had been shot
dead and Tseu Ying (周应) had been arrested by Police
attached to Central Station.

About 6 days later Sung Yah Sing called on us and after
expressing his regrets at the untimely death of Tai Ts You
(戴祖裕) told us not to be afraid but to carry on living
at this address, pending further instructions from him. We
three, i.e. Zao Liang (赵良), Wong Kwan Sai (王光才) and
myself continued to be at this room.

On or about June 20th. I again called on Doo Ts Mei
this time at the Sing Tuh (新都) lodging house, Rue Admiral
Bayle, and on this occasion Doo Ts Mei (杜芝梅) informed
me that he intended occupying Room 51 of the Dah Zung (大中华)
lodging house, Rue Auguste Boppe. I called on him once at
the latter address and discovered that he was living there
with Sung Yah Sing.

On or about the 1st. or 2nd. July 1938, Sung Yah Sing
came to our room and after explaining that he considered us
inefficient in carrying out assassination, he instructed us
that our job would be to create disturbances on July 7th.
1938, the first anniversary of the Lukachiao Incident, by
throwing bombs into the Japanese occupied areas from the
pages.zh:
江桂松

-12-

他进一步解释说，当天上午他参与了在静安寺路刺杀一名名叫尤新松（Yih Chweh Sung）的汉奸的行动，他的两名同事周应（Tsou Ying）和戴祖裕（Tai Ts You）被包围，据他所知已被租界巡捕逮捕。当晚我们在报纸上看到，戴祖裕（Tai Ts You）被枪杀，周应（Tseu Ying）被中央捕房的警察逮捕。

大约6天后，孙亚兴（Sung Yah Sing）来拜访我们，在对戴祖裕（Tai Ts You）的英年早逝表示遗憾后，告诉我们要不要害怕，继续住在这个地址，等待他的进一步指示。我们三人，即赵良（Zao Liang）、王光才（Wong Kwan Sai）和我，继续留在这个房间。

大约在6月20日，我再次去拜访杜芝梅（Doo Ts Mei），这次是在贝勒路（Rue Admiral Bayle）的新都（Sing Tuh）旅馆，此次杜芝梅（Doo Ts Mei）告诉我，他打算入住蒲柏路（Rue Auguste Boppe）的大中华（Dah Zung）旅馆51号房。我曾去该地址拜访过他一次，发现他与孙亚兴住在一起。

大约在1938年7月1日或2日，孙亚兴来到我们的房间，在解释他认为我们在执行刺杀任务方面效率低下后，他指示我们的任务是在1938年7月7日，即卢沟桥事变一周年之际，从

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-13-

International Settlement and French Concession.

At 9 p.m. on July 6th. 1938, Sung Yah Sing brought a black leather suitcase to our room in the alleyway at Rue Wagner and at this time I saw it contained several hand-grenades and two pistols. He then explained to us that we were to go out and engage another room in any hotel, remain the night therein and the following morning call back at Rue Wagner when he would give us our final instructions re the jobs we had to perform on that morning (7-7-38).

Acting on these instructions we, e.i. Zau Liang (赵良), Doo Ta Mei (杜大梅), Wong Kwan Zai (王支才), Lee Tsung Hwei (李春辉), Wong Ta Koo (王大固) and myself proceeded to the Chien Lau (中南) Hotel, Avenue Edward VII and there engaged room No.329, where we spent the night. At approximately 4 a.m. on the 7th. July, 1938, we six left the Chien Lau Hotel and proceeded to the home of Zung Hai Kwan (宗海宽) on Rue Wagner, where Sung Ya Sing (孙亚兴) met us and after handing us each a bomb, he allotted us the following jobs:-

1. Kiang Hai Chu (江海秋) alias Kiang Kwei Sung (江桂松) and I was told to proceed to the French Bund to throw a bomb into Nantao.

2. Zau Liang (赵良) was instructed to proceed to the International Settlement Bund and to throw a bomb at the Japanese River Police Station.

3. Lee Tsung Hwei (李春辉) was instructed to accompany the above to the Bund and cover his retreat if the Japanese attempted to arrest him. He was armed with a pistol.
pages.zh:
江桂松

-13-

国际租界和法租界向日本占领区投掷炸弹，制造骚乱。

1938年7月6日晚上9点，孙亚兴把一个黑色皮箱带到我们在瓦格纳路（Rue Wagner）弄堂里的房间，当时我看到里面装有几枚手榴弹和两支手枪。随后他向我们解释，我们要出去在任何一家酒店另开一个房间，在那里过夜，第二天早上回到瓦格纳路，届时他将就我们在那天上午（1938年7月7日）必须执行的任务给予最后指示。

按照这些指示，我们，即赵良（Zau Liang）、杜大梅（Doo Ta Mei）、王支才（Wong Kwan Zai）、李春辉（Lee Tsung Hwei）、王大固（Wong Ta Koo）和我，前往爱德华七世路（Avenue Edward VII）的中南（Chien Lau）酒店，开了329号房，并在那里过夜。1938年7月7日凌晨4点左右，我们六人离开中南酒店，前往瓦格纳路宗海宽（Zung Hai Kwan）的住所，孙亚兴（Sung Ya Sing）在那里迎接我们，在递给我们每人一枚炸弹后，他分配了以下任务：

1. 江海秋（Kiang Hai Chu），又名江桂松（Kiang Kwei Sung），和我被告知前往法外滩，向南市投掷一枚炸弹。

2. 赵良（Zau Liang）受命前往国际租界外滩，向日本水上警察局投掷一枚炸弹。

3. 李春辉（Lee Tsung Hwei）受命陪同上述人员前往外滩，如果日本人试图逮捕他，则掩护其撤退。他配备了一支手枪。

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

- 14 -

4. Doo Ts Moi (杜芝梅) was instructed to accompany
me and to cover my retreat should anything happen. He was
armed with a pistol.

5. Wong Kwan Zai (王芝才) was instructed to proceed to
Alabaster Road and throwing a bomb into Japanese Territory
at this point.

6. Zung Hai Nyeu (陈南之) whom we met at the room on
Rue Wagner was instructed to accompany the above to Alabaster
Road. He was also carrying a bomb.

7. Zung Hai Kwan (陈南支) and Fong Ts Koo (方子固)
both carrying bombs left at the same time as us, but where
they went to I don't know.

Prior to our departure it was decided that we would meet
in the corridor of the first floor of the Chinese Y.M.C.A.,
Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession at 12 noon that day.
At the corner of Rue Hue and Avenue Edward VII, I took a
ricsha with the object of proceeding to the French Bund, but
no sooner had I turned East into Rue du Consulat than I was
stopped by a French Police Search Party who on finding a bomb
in my possession arrested and took me to Poste Mallet Station,
I being later handed over to the Settlement Police. At time
of my arrest by French Police Doo Ts Mei was behind me and made
good his escape.

In my statement I omitted to mention that on or about
July 1st. 1938, I do not remember the exact date, Doo Ts Mei
(杜芝梅) visited me at the Tuh Shing (德兴) lodging house
and during the course of our conversation he made mention
pages.zh:
江桂松

- 14 -

4. 杜芝梅（Doo Ts Moi）受命陪同我，并在发生任何情况时掩护我撤退。他配备了一支手枪。

5. 王芝才（Wong Kwan Zai）受命前往阿尔巴斯特路（Alabaster Road），并在此处向日本领地投掷一枚炸弹。

6. 陈南之（Zung Hai Nyeu），我们在瓦格纳路的房间里遇到的人，受命陪同上述人员前往阿尔巴斯特路。他也携带了一枚炸弹。

7. 陈南支（Zung Hai Kwan）和方子固（Fong Ts Koo）都携带炸弹，与我们同时离开，但他们去了哪里我不知道。

在我们出发之前，决定于当天中午12点在法租界蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）基督教青年会一楼的走廊会面。在胡路（Rue Hue）和爱德华七世路的拐角处，我雇了一辆人力车，打算前往法外滩，但我刚向东转入领事馆路（Rue du Consulat），就被法国警察搜查队拦下，他们在我身上发现一枚炸弹后逮捕了我，并将我带到马立斯捕房（Poste Mallet Station），随后我被移交给租界巡捕。在被法国警察逮捕时，杜芝梅在我身后，成功逃脱。

在我的供词中，我遗漏了提到，大约在1938年7月1日，我不记得确切日期，杜芝梅（Doo Ts Mei）在德兴（Tuh Shing）旅馆拜访了我，在谈话过程中，他提到

pages.en:
Kiang Kwei Sung

-15-

of the fact that he intended taking his watch for repairs
to a shop on Rue Palikao, which was owned by Sung Yah Sing's
father. I said I would accompany him and together we proceeded
to the above thoroughfare where we entered a watch shop bearing
the name of Yah Mei (亜美). Doo Ts Mei (杜芝梅) appeared
to be quite friendly with the rather elderly man who attended
to us and although I did not enquire, I took it for granted
that this must be the father of Sung Yah Sing.

(Sgd.) Kiang Kwei Sung
pages.zh:
江桂松

-15-

他打算把手表送到白尔路（Rue Palikao）的一家商店去修理，这家店是孙亚兴父亲开的。我说我会陪他去，我们一起前往上述街道，进入了一家名为“亚美”（Yah Mei）的手表店。杜芝梅（Doo Ts Mei）似乎与接待我们的那位相当年长的男子关系很友好，虽然我没有询问，但我理所当然地认为这一定是孙亚兴的父亲。

（签名）江桂松
