pages.en:
The Council's Deportations
A GREAT MANY level-headed observers are inclined to view with misgiving the Shanghai Municipal Council's decision, probably born of exasperation not devoid of some anxiety about growing Japanese military displeasure concerning the disposal of terrorists in the Settlement.

This decision is attacked today in our correspondence column by an American writer while the China Press published a tempered editorial criticism yesterday. Both make the point that to hand over anyone labeled "anti-Japanese terrorist" to the Japanese at the present time is the same thing as imposing a death sentence. A mere possession of unauthorized weapons, for example, hardly warrants such punishment. At the same time there is no corresponding handing over of anti-Nationalist terrorists, such as the slayers of the late Dr. Herman Liu, to the Chinese authorities.

We cannot but agree that while the terrorist menace is grave and warranting firm measures, the Council has rather swung its balance toward the Japanese. If there was a feeling that fear of extreme punishment may deter the terrorists we may cite (quite apart from the consideration of humanity) the fact that in England and many other countries, not many decades ago, atrocious punishments were meted out for such minor offenses as purse-snatching and that these quite failed in their anticipated object.

Despite the extraordinary nature of the times, we believe that it is for that very reason important that the Council not depart from its efforts at impartiality, as between various nationalities. If this issue is to be one of deportation rather than the courts, let it be a true deportation (or "exclusion") to the territory of the deportee—in the case of a Chinese, to some Chinese-controlled area. Political considerations are to some degree involved in any attitude the Council may take, but they may be kept at a minimum by adherence to adherence to conservation and previously accepted practice.
pages.zh:
工部局的驱逐出境
许多头脑冷静的观察家倾向于以担忧的眼光看待上海公共租界工部局的决定，这一决定可能源于恼怒，同时也夹杂着对日本军方因租界内处置恐怖分子一事日益增长的不满情绪的些许焦虑。

今天，一位美国作家在我们的读者来信栏目中抨击了这一决定，而《字林西报》（China Press）昨天也发表了一篇温和的社论批评。两者都指出，在目前将任何被贴上“反日恐怖分子”标签的人移交给日本人，等同于判处死刑。仅仅拥有未经授权的武器，例如，几乎不足以证明这种惩罚是正当的。同时，并没有将反国民党恐怖分子，如杀害刘博士（Dr. Herman Liu）的凶手，相应地移交给中国当局。

我们不得不同意，虽然恐怖主义的威胁是严重的，需要采取坚决措施，但工部局的天平已相当偏向日本一方。如果有人认为对严厉惩罚的恐惧可能会震慑恐怖分子，我们可以引用（完全撇开人道主义考虑不谈）这样一个事实：就在几十年前的英国和许多其他国家，对于扒窃等轻微罪行也会施以残酷的刑罚，而这些刑罚完全未能达到预期的目的。

尽管时代非同寻常，但我们认为，正因如此，工部局在不同国籍之间保持公正的努力不偏离轨道显得尤为重要。如果这个问题是驱逐出境而不是通过法庭解决，那就让它成为真正的驱逐出境（或“排斥”）到被驱逐者的领土——对于中国人来说，就是某个由中国控制的区域。工部局采取的任何态度都在某种程度上涉及政治考量，但通过坚持保守态度和先前接受的做法，可以将这些考量降至最低。

pages.en:
China Protests
Handing Over
Of Terrorist

Police Officials Declare
S.M.C. Has Right To
Grant Powers

HANKOW, July 27.—(Reuters).—
The Chinese Government filed a
protest today with the British and
American Governments in connection
with the handing over to the Japan-
ese authorities by the International
Settlement police of an alleged
Chinese terrorist.
The action of the Council is said
to be a violation of the Shanghai
Provisional Court agreement.

Police Interviewed

The Shanghai Municipal Council
"has every legal authority to grant
the Shanghai Municipal Police the
right to use their discretion in
dealing with criminals and terror-
ists in such times as these," police
officials told THE CHINA PRESS yes-
terday.
The grant of such powers, they
declared, "does not in any way con-
flict with the Mixed Court Rendi-
tion Agreement signed between the
Chinese Government and represen-
tatives of foreign nations."
Paragraph 6 of the S.M.C. pro-
clamation of July 19, which gave
the S.M.P. authority to expel from
the Settlement those found in pos-
session of arms or explosives with-
out a permit from the Settlement
authorities, "is the direct result of
the July 7 incidents here," THE
CHINA PRESS was informed.
The paragraph was added to the
proclamation of January 1 "after
Chinese terrorists abused the pri-
vileges and protection extended to
them by the International Settle-
ment" on the anniversary of the
outbreak of the current war, the
officials declared.

Peaceful Trade Impossible

"The International Settlement,"
stated one high police official, "was
established for peaceful trade,
which, obviously, is impossible un-
der the existing conditions where
armed robbers and terrorists are
keeping the Settlement's residents
in a state of alarm.
"We are determined to keep it
safe for trade—and are prepared to
take whatever measures are necess-
ary in order to afford the greatest
possible protection to law-abiding re-
sidents within the limits of the
International Settlement.
"In order that this state of af-
fairs may be maintained," he con-
tinued, "it is obvious that the cir-
culation of illegal arms in the Set-
tlement must be stopped.
"Aside from the indisputable fact
that our actions are vindicated by
the emergency measures of the
S.M.C., it is only logical that we
should refuse to offer the Settle-
ment as a sanctuary for armed

criminals and terrorists who, while
their ideals, with which we are not
concerned, may be various, are none
the less a menace to the peace,
quiet and order of the Settlement.

Must Be Expelled

"Such offenders, obviously, can-
not be shipped away from Shang-
hai on boats together with law-
abiding citizens. They will be sim-
ply taken outside the Settlement
limits after they have been com-
pletely disarmed.
"While this does not imply that
they are thus handed over to the
custody of the Japanese military—
actually, this will be the case. In
such cases as we can prove that
terrorists in our custody have
committed an offense against armed
forces in the International Settle-
ment, they will be handed over to
the armed forces concerned, in ac-
cordance with the proclamation of
January 1," he concluded.
High officials of the various ser-
vices of the S.M.C. yesterday shook
their heads and voiced their in-
clination to believe that some
Chinese were abusing the sanctuary
of the International Settlement.
While they were vague, it was
learned that the terrorist who was
handed over to the custody of the
Japanese on Monday confessed to
having come to Shanghai with four
companions from Hankow for the
express purpose of committing acts
of violence against the Japanese
armed forces. His handing over to
the Japanese authorities, therefore,
was in complete accordance with
the January proclamation, they de-
clared.

Increase Difficulties

"In the interest of the Settle-
ment's hundreds of thousands of
peaceful residents," THE CHINA
PRESS was informed, "we (the Set-
tlement authorities) cannot permit
that it be used as a base of crim-
inal or terroristic activities by those
who are enjoying the protection
and privileges of the area in which
they operate.
"As is obvious to all, such ac-
tivities greatly increase the dif-
ferences between the S.M.C. and
the Japanese authorities. During
the past year, we have protected
thousands upon thousands of Chin-
ese men, women and children by
admitting them freely into the Set-
tlement at a time when warfare
was raging in the vicinity, and
their lives were in immediate dan-
ger.
"In return, some Chinese are now
terrorizing the city's populace with
extremist acts which, in the final
analysis, can achieve nothing but
are threatening to destroy much.
"The incidents which occurred
last July 7 must not be repeated
in the Settlement on August 13."
Meanwhile, detectives in charge
of investigation of terrorist cases in
the International Settlement were
yesterday pursuing their interro-
gation of the 29 suspects now held
in custody in connection with the
two political assassinations of last
week.
No new arrests were made, it was
learned last night, while no suspects
were handed over to the Japanese,
or turned over the boundaries.
pages.zh:
中国抗议
移交
恐怖分子

警方官员宣称
工部局有权
授予此类权力

汉口，7月27日.—（路透社）.—
中国政府今日就公共租界巡捕房将一名涉嫌为中国恐怖分子者移交给日本当局一事，向英国和美国政府提出抗议。
据称，工部局的这一行动违反了《上海临时法院协定》。

采访警方官员

上海工部局“拥有充分的法律权威，授予上海公共租界巡捕房在此类时期处理罪犯和恐怖分子时行使酌情权”，警方官员昨日对《字林西报》表示。
他们宣称，授予此类权力“绝不与中国政府与外国代表签署的《会审公廨归还协定》相冲突”。
工部局7月19日公告的第6条赋予公共租界巡捕房权力，可将那些未经租界当局许可而持有武器或炸药的人驱逐出租界，该条款“是此处7月7日事件的直接结果”，《字林西报》获悉。
官员们宣称，在现行战争爆发周年纪念日，“中国恐怖分子滥用公共租界给予他们的特权和保护”之后，该段落被添加到了1月1日的公告中。

和平贸易已不可能

一位高级警务官员表示：“公共租界的建立是为了和平贸易，而在武装劫匪和恐怖分子使租界居民处于惊恐状态的现有条件下，这显然是不可能的。
“我们决心维护贸易安全——并准备采取任何必要措施，以便在公共租界范围内为守法居民提供尽可能最大的保护。
“为了维持这种状态，”他继续说道，“显然必须制止非法武器在租界内的流通。
“除了我们的行动得到工部局紧急措施证实这一无可争辩的事实外，我们拒绝将租界作为武装罪犯和恐怖分子的庇护所也是合乎逻辑的，尽管他们的理想（我们对此并不关心）可能各不相同，但他们仍然对租界的和平、安宁和秩序构成威胁。

必须予以驱逐

“这类违法者显然不能与守法公民一起乘船运离上海。他们在被完全解除武装后，将被简单地带出租界范围。
“虽然这并不意味着他们因此被移交给日军监护——但实际上，情况将会如此。在我们能证明被我们拘留的恐怖分子在公共租界内对武装部队犯有罪行的情况下，他们将按照1月1日的公告移交给有关的武装部队，”他总结道。
工部局各部门的高级官员昨日摇头并表示，他们倾向于相信一些中国人正在滥用公共租界的庇护权。
虽然他们的说法含糊其辞，但据悉，周一被移交给日军监护的那名恐怖分子供认，他与四名同伴从汉口来到上海，明确目的是对日本武装部队实施暴力行为。因此，他们宣称，将其移交给日本当局完全符合1月的公告。

增加困难

“为了租界数十万和平居民的利益”，《字林西报》获悉，“我们（租界当局）不能允许那些享受其活动区域保护和特权的人将租界用作犯罪或恐怖活动的基地。
“正如所有人所见，此类活动大大增加了工部局与日本当局之间的分歧。在过去的一年里，我们在战火于周边地区肆虐、他们的生命面临直接危险的时候，通过自由允许成千上万的中国男女老幼进入租界，保护了他们。
“作为回报，一些中国人现在正以极端主义行为恐吓城市民众，这些行为归根结底一无所成，却有可能造成巨大破坏。
“去年7月7日发生的事件不得在8月13日于租界内重演。”
与此同时，负责调查公共租界恐怖主义案件的侦探昨日继续审讯目前因上周两起政治暗杀案而被拘留的29名嫌疑人。
据悉，昨晚没有新的逮捕行动，也没有嫌疑人被移交给日本人或被移送至边界之外。

pages.en:
Chinese Hit
Handing Over
Of Terrorists

Ratepayers' Body Here
Lodges Protest
With S.M.C.

A protest against the handing
over of Chinese who are suspected
of terroristic activities in the Inter-
national Settlement to the Japan-
ese military authorities has been
lodged by the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association with the Shanghai
Municipal Council, THE CHINA PRESS
learned yesterday.

At the same time, Mr. Stirling
Fessenden, Secretary General of the
Council, is understood to have also
received a letter from a local
Chinese resident, voicing similar
objections against the Council's
attitude regarding the handing over
of alleged Chinese terrorists.

Legal Points Discussed

While the contents of the rate-
payers' association's protest were
not divulged, THE CHINA PRESS
learned from local Chinese sources
that the communication dealt, in the
main, with the legal question enter-
ing into the issue.

The protest is said to have point-
ed out that the Council, in permit-
ting the handing over of an alleged
Chinese terrorist, has acted in con-
travention of the Mixed Court
Rendition Agreement of 1930 which
stated that any person arrested by
the S.M.P. must be brought to the
First Special District Court within
24 hours exclusive of holidays, fail-
ing which he must be released.

It is understood that no reply has
yet been made by the Council to
the association's protest.

The Council, as stated pre-
viously in THE CHINA PRESS, main-
tains that the emergency measure
which it has adopted is made
necessary by the situation existing
in the Settlement.

Measures Said Necessary

Such measures, as outlined in the
emergency proclamations of January
1 and July 19, are considered as
imperative by the Council in order
to maintain peace and order in the
area under its jurisdiction.

The Council, at the present time,
is not in a position to withhold the
execution of the regulations con-
tained in the proclamations which
were put into effect with the know-
ledge of the Consular Body.
pages.zh:
华人反对
移交
恐怖分子

本地纳税人团体
向工部局
提出抗议

《字林西报》昨日获悉，华人纳税会已向上海工部局提出抗议，反对将在公共租界内涉嫌从事恐怖活动的中国人移交给日本军事当局。

与此同时，据悉工部局总办费信惇（Stirling Fessenden）先生也收到了一封本地中国居民的来信，对工部局在处理涉嫌中国恐怖分子移交问题上的态度表达了类似的反对意见。

讨论法律要点

虽然纳税人团体抗议书的内容未予公开，但《字林西报》从本地华人消息源获悉，该函件主要涉及与此事相关的法律问题。

据称，抗议书指出，工部局允许移交一名涉嫌中国恐怖分子的行为，违反了1930年的《会审公廨归还协定》，该协定规定，凡由公共租界巡捕房逮捕的任何人员，必须在24小时内（节假日除外）送交第一特区地方法院，否则必须予以释放。

据悉，工部局尚未对该团体的抗议作出答复。

如前所述，《字林西报》曾报道，工部局坚持认为，鉴于租界内存在的局势，其采取的紧急措施是必要的。

称措施必要

工部局认为，1月1日和7月19日紧急公告中概述的此类措施对于维持其管辖区域内的和平与秩序是势在必行的。

目前，工部局无法停止执行包含在公告中的法规，这些法规是在领事团知情的情况下生效的。

pages.en:
!Terrorists HandTerrorists Handled Under
Martial Law Conditions

Court Agreement Cannot Be Adhered To Under New
Emergency Proclamation, Which Was Made
Following Wholesale Bomb Outrages

Pointing out that in order to preserve peace and order within the limits of the International Settlement, during the present unsettled conditions, the Council had to deal with terrorists under martial law conditions, an official of the Shanghai Municipal Council stated yesterday afternoon, that it was not possible to adhere, in the letter, to the Shanghai Provisional Court agreement.

The official made this statement when asked whether he had any comment to make on the protest filed by the Chinese Government at Hankow with the British and American Governments in connection with the handing over to the Japanese authorities of an alleged Chinese terrorist.

The official admitted that under the Court Agreement all suspects arrested by the Shanghai Municipal Police had to be brought before the First Special District Court within 24 hours, but pointed out that special powers were vested in the S.M.P., since the Emergency Proclamation, which was issued by the Council as a direct result of the wholesale and indiscriminate bombing all over the Settlement on the morning of July 7.

Since then the Homicide Squad of the S.M.P., formed specially to combat terrorism and political assassins, had taken into custody no less than 24 suspects, one of whom was handed over to the Japanese authorities on Monday.

The Council spokesman mentioned that the S.M.P. would try to avoid handing over alleged terrorists to the Japanese authorities, as far as possible, but if it was proved that their acts were directed against the Japanese military, they would be immediately handed over.

Questioned as to the position of the suspects arrested in connection with the various assassinations, which are believed to be of political nature, the spokesman stated that each case would be dealt with on its own merits.

In the meantime, yesterday, there were no developments in the activities of the Homicide Squad. The detectives of the newly-formed branch are completing their inquiries into the activities of the suspects now in custody.
pages.zh:
!恐怖分子在戒严状态下被处置恐怖分子在戒严状态下被处置

在新紧急公告下无法遵守法院协定，该公告是在大规模炸弹暴行后发布的

上海工部局一位官员昨日下午指出，为了在当前动荡局势下维护公共租界范围内的和平与秩序，工部局不得不在戒严状态下处理恐怖分子，因此在字面上无法遵守《上海临时法院协定》。

当被问及是否对汉口中国政府就移交一名涉嫌中国恐怖分子给日本当局一事向英美政府提出的抗议有任何评论时，该官员发表了上述声明。

该官员承认，根据《法院协定》，所有由上海公共租界巡捕房逮捕的嫌疑人都必须在24小时内送交第一特区地方法院，但他指出，自工部局因7月7日上午在整个租界范围内发生的大规模 indiscriminate（无差别）轰炸事件而发布紧急公告以来，公共租界巡捕房已被赋予特别权力。

此后，专门为打击恐怖主义和政治刺客而成立的公共租界巡捕房凶杀组已拘留了至少24名嫌疑人，其中一人于周一被移交给日本当局。

工部局发言人提到，公共租界巡捕房将尽可能避免将涉嫌恐怖分子移交给日本当局，但如果证实他们的行为是针对日本军队的，他们将立即被移交。

当被问及因涉嫌各种被认为具有政治性质的暗杀案而被捕的嫌疑人的处境时，发言人表示，每起案件将根据其具体情况进行处理。

与此同时，昨日凶杀组的行动没有新进展。新成立分支机构的侦探们正在完成对目前被拘留嫌疑人活动的调查。

pages.en:
Attitude Of Municipal
Council Against Local
Terrorists Explained

Handing Over Of Chinese With Grenade Said Authorized
29 Terrorist Suspects Still In Custody Of Police

In order to maintain the International Settlement as a sanctuary only for "those who behave," the Shanghai Municipal Council, under the present emergency circumstances, is compelled to expel those persons who are likely to cause serious disturbance of peace in the area, THE CHINA PRESS was informed by authoritative S.M.C. sources yesterday.

The question regarding the application of the recently proclaimed emergency powers granted to the Shanghai Municipal Police was brought to public attention yesterday by the handing over to the Japanese authorities of a Chinese who was arrested July 7 and who was found to be carrying a hand-grenade.

Power Requested
Approached on the question arising out of the handing over of the Chinese, S.M.C. sources gave THE CHINA PRESS to understand that after the terroristic outbreak on July 7, the S.M.P. requested the Council to grant it further emergency power than that contained in the January 1 proclamation in order to cope effectively with the situation.

This power was given to the Settlement police in the form of an additional article which reads: "Any person found in the International Settlement in possession of arms or explosive without a permit from the Settlement authorities, or engaged in or connected with terrorist activities, will be liable to be expelled from the Settlement."

Handing-Over Authorized
Furthermore, Article I of the Emergency Proclamation also states that any person committing an offense against armed forces in the International Settlement will be liable to be handed over to the armed forces concerned.

The emergency power granted to the police, the Council contends, is imperative in view of the recent terroristic outbreaks in the Settlement. The emergency conditions, it further explains, require the emergency power in order to keep the Settlement safe and achieve the aim of "greatest good for the greatest number of people."

Power Disputed
Other competent observers maintain that the Council in permitting the handing over of the alleged Chinese terrorist appeared to be acting in contravention of the Mixed Court Rendition Agreement signed between the representatives of the Powers with the Chinese Government on February 17, 1930. Article IV of this Agreement reads: "When any person is arrested by the Municipal or Judicial Police, he shall, within 24 hours, exclusive of holidays, be sent to the Courts established under the present Agreement to be dealt with, failing which he shall be released."

Detectives of the "Homicide Squad," S.M.P. Headquarters, last night still had 29 terrorist suspects, three of them women, in their hands for interrogation in connection with recent acts of terrorism in the International Settlement.

Two days ago, the total was 30, but this was reduced by one shortly before midnight Monday, when one man, alleged to have been connected with the July 7 bombings, was handed over to the Japanese authorities.

While no others were handed over yesterday, there was no indication that any of the suspects now being held will be given their release. Seven of those in custody were allegedly found in possession of firearms when arrested and this fact, according to police authorities, has made a thorough investigation of each individual case necessary.

Not Held On Court Order
The terrorist suspects now in the hands of the police are not being held in accordance with the Chinese Criminal Code, although that code is still applied in the International Settlement when the ordinary variety of criminal is arrested.

In other words, Chinese arrested for crimes committed in the International Settlement are still being tried in the First Special District Court on Chekiang Road in accordance with the Chinese laws promulgated a good many years ago by the Nationalist Government of China.

Under the terms of the Chinese Criminal Code, a man arrested for a crime, political or otherwise, must be brought before the First Special District Court within a matter of 24 hours. It is not necessary to charge him, but a writ of detention must be applied for and granted before the man can be detained for investigation.

In the case of the terrorist suspects now in the hands of the police, none has been brought before the First Special District Court although practically all of these men have been in custody for several days, at least long past the prescribed period of 24 hours required by Chinese law.

New Ruling Followed
It was explained to THE CHINA PRESS yesterday that the suspects are being detained under the terms of the new emergency proclamation issued by the Shanghai Municipal Council nine days ago. The detention of these people, it was learned, has been left to the discretion of the police. The handing over of terrorist suspects to the Japanese authorities also is entirely a police matter, according to the terms of the new emergency proclamation, the S.M.C. having given the police the power of rendering a decision in this matter.

In short, if the police believe that a man has been guilty of terrorism against the Japanese armed forces in the International Settlement, or against any other armed forces in the same area, they can hand him over without recourse to the courts. Actually, this is what the new emergency proclamation really means, a fact vividly revealed Monday night when one Chinese terrorist was handed over.

Had Bomb In Possession
When the terrorist handed over to the Japanese Monday was arrested on July 7, in the French Concession, he was found in possession of a bomb. Subsequent interrogation, it was stated in official police sources, was sufficient to implicate him in the bombings of July 7, the first anniversary of the present war in China.

In accordance with the terms of the emergency proclamation, such an individual can be refused sanctuary in the International Settlement, and, in the event that he has committed an act of aggression against an armed force represented in this area, can be turned over to such armed force. In handing over the man arrested in Frenchtown on July 7, the police were using the full scope of the powers granted them under the emergency ruling.

Well informed circles in the Settlement yesterday expressed the opinion that the situation is perhaps one of the strangest that has ever existed in the history of this area, especially from a legal point of view.

Shanghai Municipal Council officials, questioned on the subject, however, maintained that the existing situation, as far as terrorism is concerned, is an emergency measure that requires extraordinary treatment.

Meanwhile, detectives assigned to duty with the "Homicide Squad" were still on the job at a late hour last night, carrying out interrogation of the 29 suspects remaining in their hands. No new startling developments were revealed last night, and it is understood that it will be several more days before further definite action is taken against any of the suspects.

All of the suspects now in custody are being held for alleged implication in the slaying last week of Van Chi-sen, attorney said to have been mentioned for the presidency of the Special District Court in Nantao under the "Reformed Government," and Tseng Yueh-poo, of the Japanese Censorship Bureau. The man handed over to the Japanese was the only suspect held by the S.M.P. in connection with the July 7 bombings.
pages.zh:
工部局对本地恐怖分子之态度阐释

据称移交持手榴弹华人之举已获授权
29名恐怖嫌疑犯仍由警方羁押

《字林西报》昨日从工部局权威人士处获悉，为维持公共租界仅作为“守规矩者”之避难所，在当前紧急局势下，上海工部局被迫驱逐那些可能在该地区引起严重扰乱和平之人。

昨日，一名于7月7日被捕且被发现携带手榴弹的华人被移交给日本当局，此事使公众关注到近期授予上海工部局警务处的紧急权力之应用问题。

请求授权
就因移交该华人而产生的问题接受询问时，工部局人士向《字林西报》表示，在7月7日恐怖事件爆发后，工部局警务处请求工部局授予其超出1月1日公告所含范围之进一步紧急权力，以便有效应对局势。

此项权力以增补条款的形式授予租界警方，该条款规定：“凡在公共租界内被发现无租界当局许可证而持有武器或爆炸物，或参与或与恐怖活动有关联之任何人，将被驱逐出租界。”

批准移交
此外，《紧急公告》第一条亦规定，任何在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪之人，将被移交给相关武装部队。

工部局认为，鉴于租界近期发生的恐怖事件，授予警方的紧急权力势在必行。工部局进一步解释称，紧急局势需要行使紧急权力，以确保租界安全，并实现“最大多数人的最大幸福”之目标。

权力受质疑
其他有识之士坚持认为，工部局允许移交这名涉嫌恐怖活动的华人，似乎违反了1930年2月17日列强代表与中国政府签署的《混合法院交还章程》。该章程第四条规定：“凡由工部局或司法警察逮捕之任何人，除假日外，应在24小时内送交依本章程设立之法院处理，否则应予释放。”

昨晚，工部局总部“凶杀组”侦探手中仍扣押着29名恐怖嫌疑犯（其中三名为女性），就其在公共租界近期的恐怖行为进行审讯。

两天前，总数为30人，但在周一午夜前不久减少了一人，当时一名据称与7月7日爆炸案有关的男子被移交给日本当局。

虽然昨日未再移交其他人，但没有任何迹象表明目前被拘留的任何嫌疑犯将获得释放。据称，被拘留者中有七人在被捕时被发现有持有枪支，警方当局称，这一事实使得对每个案件进行彻底调查成为必要。

非依法院命令羁押
目前掌握在警方手中的恐怖嫌疑犯并非依据《中华民国刑法》被羁押，尽管在逮捕普通罪犯时，该法典仍在公共租界适用。

换言之，因在公共租界内犯罪而被捕的华人，仍依据中国国民政府多年前颁布的中国法律，在浙江路第一特区地方法院受审。

根据《中华民国刑法》之规定，因犯罪（无论是政治罪或其他罪行）被捕之人，必须在24小时内提解至第一特区地方法院。无需对其提出指控，但在对该人进行拘留调查之前，必须申请并获得拘留令。

在目前警方掌握的恐怖嫌疑犯案件中，尽管这些人实际上已被拘留数日，至少远远超过了中国法律规定的24小时期限，但无人被提解至第一特区地方法院。

遵循新裁决
昨日向《字林西报》解释说，嫌疑犯是依据上海工部局九天前发布的新《紧急公告》条款被拘留的。据悉，对这些人的拘留已交由警方酌情处理。根据新《紧急公告》的条款，将恐怖嫌疑犯移交给日本当局也完全属于警方事务，工部局已授予警方在此事上的裁决权。

简而言之，如果警方认为某人对在公共租界内的日本武装部队或该地区任何其他武装部队犯有恐怖主义罪行，他们可以在不诉诸法院的情况下将其移交。实际上，这就是新《紧急公告》的真正含义，周一晚上一名华人恐怖分子被移交一事生动地揭示了这一事实。

持有炸弹
周一被移交给日本的那名恐怖分子于7月7日在法租界被捕时，被发现拥有一枚炸弹。警方官方消息来源称，随后的审讯足以牵连其参与7月7日的爆炸案，即中国当前战争的一周年纪念日。

根据《紧急公告》的条款，此类个人可被拒绝在公共租界内避难，并且，如果其对代表该地区的武装部队实施了侵略行为，则可被移交给该武装部队。在移交7月7日在法租界（Frenchtown）被捕的男子时，警方充分行使了紧急裁决赋予他们的权力。

租界内消息灵通人士昨日表示，这种情况也许是该地区历史上出现过的最奇怪的情况之一，尤其是从法律角度来看。

然而，就此问题接受询问的上海工部局官员坚持认为，就恐怖主义而言，现有局势是一项需要特殊处理的紧急措施。

与此同时，指派给“凶杀组”执勤的侦探直到昨晚深夜仍在工作，对仍由其控制的29名嫌疑犯进行审讯。昨晚未披露任何新的惊人进展，据悉，在对任何嫌疑犯采取进一步明确行动之前，还需数日时间。

目前所有被拘留的嫌疑犯均因涉嫌参与上周杀害范志仁（Van Chi-sen，音译）律师和曾岳甫（Tseng Yueh-poo，音译，任职于日本新闻检查局）一案而被羁押。范律师据传曾被提名为“维新政府”下属南市特区地方法院院长。被移交给日本的男子是工部局警务处羁押的唯一与7月7日爆炸案有关的嫌疑犯。

pages.en:
August 5, 1938. Morning Translation

Standard publishes the following article :-

"Can Commands Alter Laws?"

It is acknowledged by students of law that commands cannot alter laws, because laws are permanent, while commands may be changed at any time to adapt them to altered circumstances. The value of law will be practically nil if it can be altered by commands.

The Agreement for the establishment of a Chinese Court in the International Settlement of Shanghai was signed between China and the following six Powers, namely Brazil, America, Britain, Norway, Holland and France. It is a law having the nature of a treaty. All the signatory Powers to this Agreement are strictly bound to observe the Agreement.

According to Article 4 of the Agreement, an offender arrested by the Police of the International Settlement must be arraigned before a Court within 24 hours of his arrest. Even if there exists a necessity to hand over the offender to an official organ outside the Settlement, such extradition will not be legal unless it had been investigated and approved by the Court.

Now, the S.M.C. in January this year issued an Emergency Proclamation in which it stipulates that any person committing an offence against armed forces in the International Settlement will be liable to be handed over to the armed forces concerned. In other words, such offenders, when arrested, can be handed over to the armed force concerned without arraignment before a Court for investigation. While the Court Rendition Agreement is still in force, such a violation of the provisions of the Agreement leads one to fear that a law may be altered by commands.

Furthermore, the man named Kiang Chiu (江秋) arrested on July 7 was not caught in the act of attacking the Japanese army; he was simply found in possession of a hand grenade and therefore his offence is one against the Regulations governing possession of guns, cannon or ammunition used for military purposes. Granted that he should be dealt with in accordance with the Emergency Proclamation of the S.M.C., then there is no reason whatever to warrant his extradition to the Japanese army. It is to be hoped that the S.M.C. will exercise care in the handling of such cases, so as not to give rise to a sense of insecurity amongst the 3,000,000 Chinese residents in the Settlement.

Apparently it is the belief of the S.M.C. that peace and order in the Settlement cannot be maintained unless such a measure is adopted. The difficulties of the S.M.C. in such a situation are understandable. However, if the S.M.C. is really solicitous for the maintenance of peace and order, it should do so by removing the cause instead of dealing with the consequence.
pages.zh:
1938年8月5日。晨间译文

《标准报》刊登如下文章：——

“命令能改变法律吗？”

法学研究者承认，命令不能改变法律，因为法律是永久性的，而命令可以随时更改以适应变化的情况。如果法律可以被命令改变，那么法律的价值实际上将荡然无存。

在上海公共租界设立中国法院的协定是由中国与以下六个强国签署的，即巴西、美国、英国、挪威、荷兰和法国。这是一项具有条约性质的法律。该协定的所有签署国均受到严格遵守该协定的约束。

根据协定第四条，由公共租界警察逮捕的罪犯必须在被捕后24小时内出庭受审。即使存在将罪犯移交给租界外官方机构的必要，除非经过法院调查并批准，否则此类引渡是不合法的。

现在，工部局在今年一月发布了《紧急公告》，其中规定，任何在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪之人，将被移交给相关武装部队。换句话说，此类罪犯在被捕时，可以在未经法院审讯调查的情况下移交给相关武装部队。虽然《法院交还章程》仍然有效，但这种违反章程规定的行为令人担心法律可能会被命令所改变。

此外，7月7日被捕的名为江秋（Kiang Chiu）的男子并非在袭击日军时被当场抓获；他只是被发现持有手榴弹，因此他的罪行是违反关于持有用于军事目的的枪支、大炮或弹药的规定。即便假定他应依据工部局的《紧急公告》进行处理，也没有任何理由证明将其引渡给日军是正当的。希望工部局在处理此类案件时谨慎行事，以免引起租界内300万中国居民的不安全感。

显然，工部局认为，除非采取此类措施，否则无法维持租界的和平与秩序。工部局在这种情况下的困难是可以理解的。然而，如果工部局真的关心维持和平与秩序，它应该通过消除原因而不是处理后果来做到这一点。

pages.en:
July 31, 1938. Morning Translation.

News Digest :-

EXTRADITION OF PRISONER TO JAPANESE AUTHORITIES CRITICIZED

On July 7, the French Police arrested on
Rue du Consulat a young Chinese who was found in possession
of a hand grenade. Maintaining that this Chinese was
connected with the bombing outrages occurring in the
International Settlement on July 7, the Shanghai Municipal
Police extradited the prisoner from the French Police.
Later the S.M.P. declared that they had found definite
evidence against the Chinese. On the authority of Article 1
of the Emergency Proclamation dated July 19, 1938, which
stated that "any person committing an offence against armed
forces in the International Settlement will be liable to
be handed over to the armed forces concerned", the Shanghai
Municipal Council handed over the Chinese to the Japanese
military authorities. It is said that the suspects
arrested recently in connection with assassinations will
also be handed over to the Japanese authorities.

These measures have caused great alarm and
anxiety to foreign and Chinese residents, especially the
latter. Disagreeing with the decision of the Council,
local foreign newspapers unanimously published editorials
yesterday criticizing the Council's action. Some British
and American residents even sent letters of protest to the
Council. The Chinese Government has lodged a protest with
Great Britain and the U.S.A. over the extraditing of
"patriotic offenders", and all local Chinese residents are
hoping that the Council will protect the Chinese in the
International Settlement in an impartial manner and will
quickly get back the extradited prisoner and release him
according to law. They are also hoping that the tens of
so-called "suspected terrorists" now under detention will
be sent to Court for trial or released. It is reported
that the Chinese Ratepayers' Association will appeal to
the Council to protect the lives of the Chinese residents
according to law and rectify its action of handing over
"patriotic offenders" in compliance with the wish of the
Japanese.

Law experts have expressed the opinion that
the emergency measures proclaimed by the S.M.C. in the first
place contradicted the Court Agreement signed between China
and the various Powers on February 17, 1930, for Article 6
of the Court Agreement provides that a prisoner arrested in
the International Settlement must be arraigned before the
Court within twenty-four hours, excluding holidays, or he
should be released. Now that the Council has proclaimed
the measures, the residents are powerless to do anything
except to hope that the measures will be applied with great
discretion. The Chinese who has been handed over to the
Japanese authorities, however, did not commit any offence
against the Japanese armed forces, even though he might
have been connected with the July 7 bombings. The action
of the Council is therefore in contradiction with its
emergency proclamation. The Council should immediately
rectify this action so as to reassure the public.
pages.zh:
1938年7月31日。晨间译稿。

新闻摘要：-

引渡囚犯予日本当局之举遭批评

7月7日，法国警察在领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）逮捕了一名年轻华人，发现其持有一枚手榴弹。上海公共租界工部局警务处声称该华人与7月7日发生在公共租界的爆炸暴行有关，遂从法国警察手中引渡了该囚犯。随后，工部局警务处宣称已掌握针对该华人的确凿证据。依据1938年7月19日颁布的《紧急公告》第一条，该条规定“任何在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪之人，将被移交给相关武装部队”，上海公共租界工部局将该华人移交给了日本军方当局。据悉，近期因暗杀案被捕的嫌疑人也将被移交给日本当局。

这些措施引起了外籍和华人居民的极大恐慌和焦虑，尤其是后者。当地外文报纸昨日一致发表社论，批评工部局的决定。一些英美居民甚至向工部局递交了抗议信。中国政府就引渡“爱国罪犯”一事向英国和美国提出抗议，所有本地华人居民都希望工部局能公正地保护公共租界内的华人，并迅速追回被引渡的囚犯，依法予以释放。他们还希望目前被拘留的数十名所谓“嫌疑恐怖分子”能被送交法庭审判或予以释放。据报道，华人纳税会将会向工部局呼吁，要求依法保护华人居民的生命安全，并纠正其顺应日本意愿引渡“爱国罪犯”的行为。

法律专家表示，工部局最初宣布的紧急措施违背了中国与各列强于1930年2月17日签署的《法院协定》，因为该协定第六条规定，在公共租界逮捕的囚犯必须在二十四小时内（节假日除外）送交法庭受审，否则应予释放。既然工部局已经宣布了这些措施，居民们除了希望这些措施能得到极其慎重的适用外，别无他法。然而，被移交给日本当局的这名华人并未对日本武装部队犯下任何罪行，尽管他可能与7月7日的爆炸案有关。因此，工部局的行为与其紧急公告相矛盾。工部局应立即纠正这一行为，以安抚公众。

pages.en:
July 31, 1938. Morning Translation.

Hwa Mei Jen Peo dated July 29 :-

ASSASSINATIONS IN SHANGHAI

Numerous cases of assassination have taken place
in Shanghai during the past few days. More than 20
persons are at present held in the custody of the Police.
According to information, it is learned that
following the arrest of these suspects, the Japanese
authorities have made several representations to the
S.M.C. requesting the extradition of these persons. It
is said that the Council has decided to bring up the matter
for discussion at the next meeting.
According to jurists, the arrested persons should
be arraigned before the Special District Court to be dealt
with , because though the S.M.P. are dealing with this
matter in accordance with one of the articles of the
Emergency Measures recently proclaimed by the S.M.C.
which states "That any person committing an offence
against armed forces in the International Settlement will
be liable to be handed over to the armed forces concerned",
yet this is contradictory to the provisions of Article 6
of the agreement concluded between the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs of the Chinese Government and the Consular Body.
Moreover, almost in every case, there are always some who
are innocent amongst the arrested persons. General
excitement and uneasiness will very likely be created
among the residents in the Settlement as they will feel
that they are not provided with adequate protection. This
is a matter that will have some repercussions upon the
peace and order of the Settlement.
pages.zh:
1938年7月31日。晨间译稿。

7月29日《华美日报》：-

上海暗杀案

过去几天，上海发生了多起暗杀案件。目前有20多人被警方羁押。据消息人士透露，在这些嫌疑人被捕后，日本当局已向工部局多次交涉，要求引渡这些人。据说工部局已决定在下次会议上讨论此事。
据法学家称，被捕人员应送交特区法院处理，因为虽然工部局警务处是根据工部局最近颁布的《紧急措施》中的一条条款来处理此事，该条款规定“任何在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪之人，将被移交给相关武装部队”，但这与中国政府外交部与领事团达成的协定第六条规定相矛盾。此外，几乎在每一起案件中，被捕人员中总有一些是无辜的。这很可能在租界居民中引起普遍的激动和不安，因为他们会觉得自己没有得到充分的保护。这是一个会对租界的和平与秩序产生一定影响的问题。

pages.en:
August 1, 1938.
Afternoon Translation. 8597/8

News Digest publishes the following editorial :-

COUNCIL ADVISED TO RECTIFY IRREGULARITY

The extradition to the Japanese of a Chinese named Kiang Chiu (江秋), who is suspected of being connected with the bomb outrages on July 7, has created a bad impression among the foreign and Chinese residents and has given rise to a general feeling of anxiety. We wish to say a few words in addition to the views already expressed in our editorial yesterday.

The object of the S.M.C. in extraditing the prisoner without legal grounds is, primarily, to warn Chinese patriots against radical acts. As we stated yesterday, no force whatsoever can destroy the feelings of the Chinese people. The Japanese have cruelly bombed and killed no less than a million Chinese people in the present war hoping that this would weaken their morale, but the result has been just the contrary. It is thus evident that the extraditing of Kiang Chiu will not help towards the maintenance of peace and order in the Settlement.

Here we wish to draw the attention of the Council to the Japanese plot. In their efforts to coerce the S.M.C. into submitting to their wishes the Japanese are not only aiming at the extermination of anti-Japanese elements, but are, at the same time, hoping to create an anti-Council and anti-British feeling among the Chinese. Of course, the Chinese realize the position of the Council and the history of 1925 will certainly not be repeated in this case; nevertheless, the Council should beware lest it should, by improperly giving way to the demands of the Japanese, leave an impression of partiality in the minds of the Chinese people.

On many occasions Chinese residents in the Settlement have disappeared, apparently victims of political kidnappings. Many cases have also occurred wherein the Japanese have openly and freely made arrests in the Settlement. Large and small traitors are active everywhere with the Settlement authorities looking on helplessly. Under such circumstances, it is only natural for radical Chinese elements to lose control of their feelings. The best measure to prevent terrorist activities is therefore to put a stop to the occurrences which are the main cause of terrorist activities.

The terrorist cases occurring on July 7 were directed mostly against Chinese traitors. No injury was caused to the Japanese armed forces; therefore, the Emergency Proclamation of the Council was not violated and there is no reason therefore for Kiang Chiu to be handed over to the Japanese. If the S.M.C. holds the view that Article 1 of the Emergency Measures can be applied to any terrorist, then the Chinese residents can expect no protection from law, because the Police, at the instance of the Japanese, can always distort the meaning of a law. Chinese will then come to regard the Settlement as a dangerous spot instead of as a safety zone and will escape from it. Thus the prosperity of the Settlement will be gone.

The slip made by the Settlement authorities in regard to the case of Kiang Chiu has aroused anxiety among foreign and Chinese residents alike. Heated criticisms have been made by foreign newspapers. In order to reassure the residents, the authorities should rectify the irregularity and not try to cover up the mistake.
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。
午后译稿。 8597/8

《新闻摘要》发表如下社论：-

建议工部局纠正违规行为

涉嫌与7月7日爆炸暴行有关的华人江秋（Kiang Chiu）被引渡给日本，在外籍和华人居民中造成了不良印象，并引发了普遍的焦虑情绪。除了我们在昨日社论中表达的观点外，我们还想再说几句。

工部局在没有法律依据的情况下引渡囚犯，其主要目的是警告中国爱国者不要采取激进行动。正如我们昨天所述，没有任何力量能够摧毁中国人民的感情。日本人在当前的战争中残酷地轰炸和杀害了不少于一百万中国人，希望以此削弱他们的士气，但结果却恰恰相反。因此，显而易见，引渡江秋无助于维持租界的和平与秩序。

在此，我们要提请工部局注意日本的阴谋。日本人在迫使工部局顺从其意愿的努力中，不仅旨在消灭反日分子，同时也希望在华人中制造反工部局和反英的情绪。当然，中国人明白工部局的处境，1925年的历史肯定不会在此重演；尽管如此，工部局仍应警惕，以免因不当让步于日本的要求而在中国人民心中留下偏袒的印象。

在许多场合，租界内的华人居民失踪，显然是政治绑架的受害者。也发生过许多日本人在租界内公开且自由地进行逮捕的案件。大大小小的汉奸到处活动，而租界当局只能无助地旁观。在这种情况下，激进的华人分子失去情感控制是自然而然的。因此，防止恐怖活动的最佳措施是制止导致恐怖活动发生的主要原因。

7月7日发生的恐怖案件主要针对的是中国汉奸。日本武装部队未受到伤害；因此，工部局的《紧急公告》并未被违反，也就没有理由将江秋移交给日本。如果工部局认为《紧急措施》第一条可以适用于任何恐怖分子，那么华人居民将无法指望得到法律保护，因为警方可以在日本的指使下随意曲解法律的含义。中国人随后会将租界视为危险之地而非安全区，并从中逃离。这样，租界的繁荣将不复存在。

租界当局在江秋一案中的失误引起了外籍和华人居民的共同焦虑。外文报纸对此进行了激烈的批评。为了安抚居民，当局应纠正这一违规行为，而不是试图掩盖错误。

pages.en:
News Digest published the following editorial on July 31:-

EXTRADITION OF TERRORISTS INADVISABLE AND
UNREASONABLE

The other day foreign and Chinese newspapers
published a report about the handing over of a Chinese
terrorist by the authorities of the International
Settlement to the Japanese military authorities in Hongkew.
At first we did not believe this to be true because the
act seemed to be beyond reason. When we learned that a
protest had been lodged by the Chinese Government and that
the Shanghai Municipal Council had declared that "the
Police have been vested with the proper authority", we
began to realize that the report was true, but we
pages.zh:
《新闻摘要》于7月31日发表了如下社论：-

引渡恐怖分子既不明智也不合理

日前，中外报纸刊登了一则关于公共租界当局将一名中国恐怖分子移交给虹口日本军事当局的报道。起初我们不相信这是真的，因为这种行为似乎不合情理。当我们得知中国政府已提出抗议，且上海公共租界工部局宣称“警方已被授予适当权力”时，我们开始意识到该报道属实，但我们

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Morning Translation.

refrained from making any harsh criticisms because we
were in hopes that the Council would give proper
consideration to the Chinese Government's protest and
dispose of the other so-called terrorists in a more
proper way.
Unexpectedly, the "China Press" of
July 30 reported that the Council will hand over 12 more
terrorists to the Japanese. Such action will be both
inadvisable and unreasonable, for the following reasons:-
(1) Administrative power is vested in
the Shanghai Municipal Council by the Chinese Government.
In exercising this power, the Council should maintain a
neutral stand. The Council also has no legal right to
amend or abolish the provisions of the Court Agreement,
signed between the Chinese Government and the Powers
concerned in 1930, which states that "prisoners arrested
in the International Settlement must be sent to Court
within 24 hours, excluding holidays, or they should be
released."
In January this year the S.M.C. issued
an Emergency Proclamation stating that any person who
commits an offence against armed forces in the Inter-
national Settlement would be handed over to the armed
forces concerned. A protest was lodged by the Chinese
Government as soon as this proclamation was issued. The
S.M.C. will be handing over Chinese prisoners on no other
legal basis than the Emergency Proclamation referred to
above, which cannot be binding, in view of the protest of
the Chinese Government.
(2) Even if we accept the Emergency
Proclamation, no terrorists should be handed over to the
Japanese unless they had actually attacked the Japanese
armed forces. Of all the news reports published since
July 7, not one has referred to any attack on any Japanese
armed force by Chinese terrorists. Therefore, the S.M.C.
has no occasion to apply the provisions of the Emergency
Proclamation. Perhaps, it will not be out of place to
mention here an incident which occurred shortly after
the promulgation of the Emergency Proclamation and in
which a British military officer was attacked by Japanese
soldiers in Jessfield Village. Although a protest was
launched by the British Military Commander, the S.M.C.
never demanded under the Emergency Proclamation, the
extradition of the person or persons responsible for the
attack.
Why should the S.M.C., after having
itself repudiated the practical value of the Proclamation,
now enforce it against Chinese in a case in which it is
hardly applicable?
(3) There are a number of Japanese on
the S.M.C., but the privileges of Japanese in the
International Settlement can only be enforced through
the S.M.C. Neither the authority of the Japanese army
nor even that of the Japanese gendarmes can replace the
police rights of the S.M.C.
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。晨间译稿。

克制未作严厉批评，因为我们希望工部局能适当考虑中国政府的抗议，并以更恰当的方式处理其他所谓的恐怖分子。
出乎意料的是，7月30日的《字林西报》（China Press）报道说，工部局将再把12名恐怖分子移交给日本。这种行为既不明智也不合理，原因如下：-
(1) 行政权由中国政府赋予上海公共租界工部局。在行使这一权力时，工部局应保持中立立场。工部局也无权修改或废除中国政府与有关列强于1930年签署的《法院协定》的规定，该协定规定“在公共租界逮捕的囚犯必须在24小时内（节假日除外）送交法庭，否则应予释放。”
今年一月，工部局发布了一项《紧急公告》，声明任何在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪的人将被移交给相关武装部队。该公告一经发布，中国政府即提出抗议。工部局移交中国囚犯的唯一法律依据就是上述《紧急公告》，鉴于中国政府的抗议，该公告不具有约束力。
(2) 即使我们接受《紧急公告》，除非恐怖分子实际攻击了日本武装部队，否则不应将其移交给日本。自7月7日以来发布的所有新闻报道中，没有一篇提到中国恐怖分子对任何日本武装部队发动攻击。因此，工部局没有机会适用《紧急公告》的规定。也许在此提及《紧急公告》颁布后不久发生的一件事并不为过，当时一名英国军官在极司菲尔村（Jessfield Village）遭到日本士兵袭击。虽然英国军事指挥官提出了抗议，但工部局从未根据《紧急公告》要求引渡袭击的责任人。
为什么工部局在自行否定了该公告的实际效力后，现在却在一个几乎不适用的案件中对中国强制执行该公告？
(3) 工部局中有数名日本人，但日本人在公共租界的特权只能通过工部局来执行。日本军队的权威，甚至日本宪兵的权威，都不能取代工部局警务处的警察权。

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Morning Translation

But what is actually the situation? Every-
thing causes us to express our fears for the S.M.C. It
should be borne in mind that Japan's atrocious acts have
merely served to excite the feelings of the Chinese people
and are the cause of the terroristic activities. In this
regard, the S.M.C. has actually shown excessive weakness.
We have already said that it is impossible
to maintain peace and order in Shanghai by a compromise
with the aggressor. The greater the compromise, the more
pressing will be the aggressor, while the anger of the
Chinese people will rise higher and once this anger gets
beyond control, unlawful acts of terrorism will ensue, and
the blame will be placed upon the "passive party."
(4) The authorities of the International
Settlement have declared: "The creation of the Inter-
national Settlement is for the purpose of peace transaction
of business. If the alarming activities frequently
indulged in by armed bandits and terrorist elements cause
uneasiness to the community, then peace and commerce are
impossible." This is quite true. However, the Chinese
Government and the peaceful Chinese residents do not object
to the S.M.C. adopting lawful measures for the maintenance
of peace and order; in particular, they hope that the S.M.C.
will put a check to abduction by political bandits so as
to protect the residents. Moreover, if it is really
desired to maintain peaceful commerce, the first requisite
is to put a stop to all unlawful acts by Japanese
soldiers and secondly due regard must be paid to the
susceptibilities of the Chinese people. The handing
over of Chinese by the S.M.C. to the Japanese army will
only arouse fear and anger among the Chinese and will not
assure peaceful commerce; on the contrary it will aggravate
the situation.
In all sincerity, we hope that the
authorities of the International Settlement will
courageously understand that the extradition of the
so-called "terrorist element" has already created a bad
impression among the Chinese and foreign community and
this is decidedly against the policy of co-operation
with the residents declared by the authorities. In order
to manifest their impartial stand, the Settlement
authorities should promptly rectify this measure, secure
the return of the extradited "terrorist element" from the
Japanese army and bring him before a Court to be dealt
with according to law. All the suspects now under
detention should also be brought before the Court for
disposal.
In the meantime, we hope that the
responsible officials of the Chinese Ratepayers'
Association and various public bodies, as representatives
of the Chinese residents, will sincerely and resolutely
appeal to the S.M.C. to give immediate heed to Chinese
and foreign public opinion and to rectify the extraditing of
the "terrorist element."
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。晨间译文

但实际情况究竟如何？种种事态令我们对工部局（S.M.C.）深感忧虑。必须铭记，日本的暴行 merely 激起了中国人民的情绪，也是恐怖活动产生的原因。在这方面，工部局实际上表现出过度的软弱。我们已指出，通过与侵略者妥协来维持上海的和平与秩序是不可能的。妥协越多，侵略者的逼迫就越紧，而中国人民的愤怒也会越高涨；一旦这种愤怒失控，非法的恐怖行为便会随之发生，而责任将被归咎于“被动方”。

(4) 公共租界当局宣称：“设立公共租界的目的是为了和平地进行商业交易。如果武装匪徒和恐怖分子频繁从事令人惊恐的活动，导致社会不安，那么和平与商业便不可能实现。”此言甚是。然而，中国政府及和平的中国居民并不反对工部局采取合法措施以维持治安；特别是，他们希望工部局能制止政治匪徒的绑架行为，以保护居民。此外，若真欲维持和平的商业环境，首要条件是制止日本士兵的一切非法行为，其次必须充分顾及中国人民的感受。工部局将中国人移交给日军，只会引起中国人的恐惧和愤怒，并不能保障和平的商业；相反，这将加剧局势的恶化。

我们真诚地希望，公共租界当局能勇敢地认识到，引渡所谓的“恐怖分子”已在中外社群中造成不良印象，这显然违背了当局所宣布的与居民合作的政策。为了表明其公正立场，租界当局应立即纠正这一措施，从日军处索回被引渡的“恐怖分子”，并将其提交法庭依法审理。目前所有被拘留的嫌疑犯也应提交法庭处理。

与此同时，我们希望作为中国居民代表的华人纳税会及各公共团体的负责官员，能真诚而坚决地呼吁工部局立即重视中外舆论，并纠正引渡“恐怖分子”的做法。

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

Hwa Mei Chen Pao (Editorial) dated July 31 :-

OBSERVANCE OF THE COURT AGREEMENT AND THE MAINTENANCE
OF PEACE AND ORDER WITHIN THE SETTLEMENTS

Since the outbreak of hostilities in
Shanghai last year, the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements have always maintained a neutral attitude
and have made energetic efforts to maintain peace and
order within their jurisdiction. This spirit is indeed
worthy of the highest praise.
However, we have to draw the attention
of both the foreign and Chinese residents to the fact
that though the Settlements are maintaining neutrality,
they should observe and do everything possible to support
the agreement concluded between the Chinese Government
and Great Britain, France, the U.S.A. and other Powers
who are responsible for the maintenance of the Foreign
Settlements. Immediately after the outbreak of the
local hostilities, the Japanese military authorities
converted the eastern and the northern districts of the
Settlement into a base for their military operations.
Up to the present, these two districts have not yet
returned to normalcy.
If the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements desire to maintain peace and order within
their jurisdiction to-day, they should exert their
utmost to maintain the independence of their administra-
tion free from outside influence and pressure. They
should especially be determined to observe all agreements
concluded with the Chinese Government. It is only by
doing this that they can maintain their position of
neutrality and deserve respect and commendation from the
local community.
We fully realize the difficulties
confronting the authorities of the Foreign Settlements
under the present extraordinary circumstances and we
are in sympathy with their efforts to maintain peace
and order. However, when a situation arises that
necessitates the adoption of emergency measures, such
measures should be in accordance with the provisions of
the treaties and agreements, otherwise they would be
contrary to these treaties and agreements and will
constitute a breach of neutrality.
Take, for instance, the recent
extradition of a Chinese terrorist to the Japanese
military authorities by the S.M.C. This action on the
part of the authorities of the Settlement has created
much anxiety in the minds of the residents of Shanghai
and doubts have been raised as to whether the authorities
of the Settlements and the various Powers concerned are
determined to observe the original treaties and agreements.
Article 6 of the Special District Court
Agreement clearly states that any person who is arrested
in the Foreign Settlements, excepting holidays, should be
arraigned before the Court concerned within 24 hours after
arrest, or else he should be released. As the S.M.C.
had failed to bring the Chinese terrorist to Court within
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。午后译文。

《华美晨报》7月31日社论：

遵守法院协定与维护租界内的和平秩序

自去年上海战事爆发以来，外国租界当局始终保持中立态度，并竭力维持其辖区内的和平与秩序。这种精神确实值得高度赞扬。

然而，我们必须提请中外居民注意，尽管租界保持中立，但仍应遵守并尽其所能支持中国政府与负责维持外国租界的英国、法国、美国及其他列强之间达成的协定。当地战事爆发后不久，日本军方当局便将租界的东部和北部地区转化为其军事行动基地。迄今为止，这两个地区尚未恢复正常。

如果外国租界当局希望今日在其辖区内维持和平与秩序，就应竭尽全力保持其行政独立性，不受外界影响和压力。他们尤其应决心遵守与中国政府达成的所有协定。只有这样做，他们才能维持其中立地位，并赢得本地社会的尊重和赞誉。

我们充分认识到，在当前非常情况下，外国租界当局面临的困难，并对他们为维持和平与秩序所作的努力表示同情。然而，当出现需要采取紧急措施的情况时，此类措施应符合条约和协定的规定，否则将违背这些条约和协定，并构成对中立地位的破坏。

以近期工部局将一名中国恐怖分子引渡给日本军方当局为例。租界当局的这一举动在上海居民心中引起了极大焦虑，人们不禁怀疑租界当局及相关列强是否决心遵守原有的条约和协定。

《特区法院协定》第六条明确规定，在外国租界被捕的任何人员，除假日外，应在逮捕后24小时内送交有关法院受审，否则应予释放。由于工部局未能在

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

24 hours after his arrest, it is only natural that a
doubt has been raised in the minds of the public as to
whether this terrorist was guilty or innocent. Moreover,
even the prisoner is found to have committed some
criminal offence, he should have been charged in Court
to be dealt with according to law; there is absolutely
no ground for the S.M.C. to hand him to the Japanese
military authorities. The action of the Police authorities
in failing to arraign this man before the Court 24 hours
after his arrest is a departure from their usual efficiency
of administering the Settlement according to legal
procedure and constitutes a violation of the treaties
concluded between China and the Powers concerned.
This action of the S.M.C. is also
contrary to the provisions of the emergency measures
proclaimed by the Council. According to newspaper reports,
the prisoner had not committed any terroristic activities
against any armed force; his aim was to deal with
Chinese or certain foreign nationals. Article 1 of the
emergency measures provides that any person committing
an offence against armed forces in the International
Settlement will be liable to be handed over to the armed
force concerned. The measures did not provide that any
person committing an offence against certain foreign
nationals will also be liable to be handed over to the
armed force concerned. This affair has become the general
topic of conversation in Shanghai. Moreover there is a
general fear of some calamity overtaking the Chinese
residents. Though the Chinese residents in the International
International Settlement, who represent over 95% of the
population in the Settlement, regard with concern the
assassinations, abductions and illegal arrest of Chinese
people by the certain authorities without advance notice
to the police, they had never lost confidence in the
authorities of the Settlement; but to-day they feel much
distressed over the action of the Council in handing over
the "July 7 terrorist" to the Japanese military authorities.
Assassinations, illegal arrests of Chinese people, etc.
are unlawful and constitute a war-time phenomenon, but
the extradition of the terrorist was effected by an
administrative organ which has been known for its spirit
of strict observance of the law.
The supreme authorities of the
International Settlement, namely, the foreign ratepayers'
meeting and the Chinese Ratepayers' Association, should
at once come forward and rectify this irregularity, while
the principals directing the administration of the
International Settlement, namely, the Councillors elected
by the local foreign and Chinese residents, should likewise
come forward to rectify the mistake that has been made by
the Council, otherwise the Chinese residents in the
Settlement will feel themselves in danger because of
lack of adequate protection. This is liable to have
repercussions upon the future status of the Settlement.
In conclusion, we submit the following
views regarding terroristic activities for consideration
by the residents in Shanghai, especially the Chinese
people:-
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。午后译文。

逮捕该恐怖分子后的24小时内将其送交法院，公众自然对其有罪与否产生怀疑。此外，即使该囚犯被认定犯有某种刑事罪行，也应在法院起诉并依法处理；工部局将其移交给日本军方当局绝对没有任何理由。警方当局未在逮捕后24小时内将此人在法院提审，背离了其以往依法管理租界的高效作风，并构成了对中国与相关列强所缔结条约的违反。

工部局的这一行动也违背了工部局颁布的紧急措施的规定。据报纸报道，该囚犯并未对任何武装部队实施恐怖活动；其目标是对付中国人或某些外籍人士。紧急措施第一条规定，在公共租界内对武装部队犯罪的人，可被移交给有关的武装部队。但该措施并未规定对某些外籍人士犯罪的人也可被移交给有关的武装部队。此事已成为上海普遍谈论的话题。此外，人们普遍担心中国居民会遭遇某种灾难。虽然占租界人口95%以上的公共租界中国居民，对于某些当局在未预先通知警方的情况下刺杀、绑架和非法逮捕中国人的行为感到关切，但他们从未对租界当局失去信心；然而今天，他们对工部局将“七七恐怖分子”移交给日本军方当局的举动感到非常痛苦。

刺杀、非法逮捕中国人等行为是非法的，属于战时现象，但引渡该恐怖分子是由一个以严格守法精神著称的行政机关执行的。

公共租界的最高权力机构，即外侨纳税人大会和华人纳税会，应立即出面纠正这一违规行为；而指导公共租界行政的主要负责人，即由当地中外居民选举产生的董事，也应出面纠正工部局所犯的错误，否则租界内的中国居民将因缺乏充分保护而感到自身处于危险之中。这可能会对未来租界的地位产生反响。

最后，我们就恐怖活动提出以下观点，供上海居民，尤其是中国人民考虑：

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Afternoon Translation.

(1) In principle, terroristic activities
can produce little result, because it only shows that the
party responsible for such terrorism does not have the
confidence of the public. Take, for instance, the murder
of Dr. Herman C.E. Liu (刘湛恩) by certain authorities.
It has in no way affected the determination of those who
are unwilling to become traitors.
(2) In view of the present conditions
in Shanghai, it is no exaggeration to say that some of
the terroristic activities were perpetrated by Chinese
patriotic elements. From a patriotic point of view, their
zeal is worthy of praise, but the methods they use to
demonstrate their patriotism are improper. It should
not be overlooked that the best way to deal with traitors
is to mobilize the entire force of the people. Anyone
who has become a traitor should be denounced not only by
his parents and wives but also by his relations and
friends. If this can be done, it will be more effective
than to bring about his death. What is more important
is that measures should be devised to prevent one from
becoming a traitor. To achieve this, the united force
of the entire mass is indispensable.
(3) To commit terroristic activities
against Japanese nationals is childish and disadvantageous
and can produce no practical results. This is quite
obvious.
We appeal to the authorities of the
International Settlement to maintain their spirit of
justice; we appeal to the residents in the Settlement
to refrain from unnecessary movements and activities,
thereby creating more difficulties for the Settlement
authorities.

Ta Ying Yeh Pao Dated July 31 (Brief Comment) :-

It is said that following the
extradition of Kiang Chiu (江秋), a suspect in the
bombing outrages, ten other suspects will be handed
over to the Japanese in the near future.
Yesterday the foreign registered
Chinese evening papers and the morning papers of
today expressed their views on the action of the Council.
We do not wish to say much, but we sincerely hope that
the Chinese community in the International Settlement
will pay close attention to this matter and try to
realize what it will mean to them. In particular, we
suggest that the S.M.C. handle the matter with prudence
and not alter its usual neutral attitude.

1938年8月1日。午后译文。

(1) 原则上，恐怖活动收效甚微，因为它只表明负责此类恐怖活动的一方缺乏公众的信任。例如，某些当局谋杀刘湛恩博士（Dr. Herman C.E. Liu）。这丝毫没有影响那些不愿成为汉奸的人的决心。

(2) 鉴于上海目前的状况，毫不夸张地说，部分恐怖活动是由中国爱国分子所为。从爱国角度来看，他们的热情值得赞扬，但他们表达爱国之情的方式是不恰当的。不应忽视的是，对付汉奸的最佳方式是动员全民的力量。任何成为汉奸的人，不仅应受到其父母和妻子的谴责，还应受到其亲友的谴责。如果能做到这一点，比致其死亡更为有效。更重要的是，应制定措施防止人们成为汉奸。为此，整个民众的联合力量是必不可少的。

(3) 对日本国民实施恐怖活动是幼稚且不利的，不会产生任何实际结果。这是显而易见的。

我们呼吁公共租界当局保持其正义精神；我们呼吁租界居民避免不必要的行动和活动，从而给租界当局制造更多困难。

《大英夜报》7月31日（短评）：

据悉，继涉嫌爆炸案的江秋（Kiang Chiu）被引渡后，另有十名嫌疑人将在近期被移交给日本人。

昨日外文注册的中文晚报及今日晨报均对工部局的行动发表了看法。我们不想多言，但真诚希望公共租界的华人社区密切关注此事，并试图理解这对他们意味着什么。特别是，我们建议工部局谨慎处理此事，不要改变其通常的中立态度。

August 1, 1938. Morning Translation

Ta Kei Pao published the following editorial on July 31 :-

DEPORTATION OF TERRORISTS

A great many level-headed observers are inclined to view with misgiving the Shanghai Municipal Council's decision, probably born of exasperation not devoid of some anxiety about growing Japanese military displeasure, concerning the disposal of terrorists in the Settlement.

This decision was attacked yesterday in our correspondence column by an American writer, while the "China Press" published a tempered editorial of criticism. Both make the point that to hand over anyone labelled "anti-Japanese terrorist" to the Japanese at the present time is the same thing as imposing a death sentence. A mere possession of unauthorized weapons, for example, hardly warrants such punishment. At the same time there is no corresponding handing over of anti-Nationalist terrorists, such as the slayers of the late Dr. Herman Liu, to the Chinese authorities.

We agree that measures should be adopted to put an end to terrorist activities. However, the attitude of the S.M.C. is too much pro-Japanese. If there was a feeling that fear of extreme punishment may deter the terrorists we may cite (quite apart from the consideration of inhumanity) the fact that in England and many other countries, not many decades ago, atrocious punishments were meted out for such minor offences as purse-snatching and that these quite failed in their anticipated object.

Despite the extraordinary nature of the times, we believe that it is for that very reason important that the Council should not depart from its efforts at impartiality, as between various nationalities. If this issue is to be one of deportation rather than the courts, let it be a true deportation (or "exclusion") to the territory of the deportee - in the case of a Chinese, to some Chinese-controlled area. Political considerations are to some degree involved in any attitude the Council may take, but they may be kept at a minimum by adherence to conservation and previously accepted practice.
pages.zh:
1938年8月1日。晨间译稿

《大公报》于7月31日发表如下社论：

驱逐恐怖分子

许多头脑冷静的观察家倾向于以忧虑的眼光看待上海公共租界工部局关于处置租界内恐怖分子的决定，该决定可能是出于愤慨，同时也夹杂着对日本军方日益增长的不满情绪的某种焦虑。

昨日，一位美国作家在我们的通讯专栏中抨击了这一决定，而《字林西报》则发表了一篇措辞温和的批评社论。两者均指出，在目前将任何被贴上“反日恐怖分子”标签的人移交给日本人，无异于判处死刑。例如，仅仅持有未经授权的武器，几乎不足以招致如此惩罚。与此同时，并没有将反国民政府的恐怖分子（如杀害刘博士[注：即刘湛恩]的凶手）移交给中国当局的相应举措。

我们同意应当采取措施终止恐怖活动。然而，工部局的态度过于亲日。如果有人认为对极端惩罚的恐惧可能会震慑恐怖分子，我们可以引用（且不谈不人道这一考量）这样一个事实：就在几十年前的英国和许多其他国家，对于扒窃等轻微罪行曾施以残酷的刑罚，但这些刑罚完全未能达到预期的目的。

尽管时局非凡，但我们认为，正因如此，工部局在各国籍之间保持公正的努力才显得尤为重要，不应偏离这一轨道。如果此事涉及的是驱逐而非司法审判，那就应进行真正的驱逐（或“排斥”），即将其遣返至被驱逐者的所属领土——如果是中国人，则遣返至由中国控制的区域。工部局采取的任何态度在某种程度上都涉及政治考量，但通过坚持保守原则和既往惯例，可以将这些考量降至最低。

pages.en:
August 1, 1938. Morning Translation.

Morning Leader (Comment) dated July 31 :-

MUCH ANXIETY EXISTS AMONGST RESIDENTS OF FOREIGN SETTLEMENT

The population in the Central and Western
Districts of the International Settlement and the French
Concession has increased manifold since the outbreak of
hostilities on August 13 last year. The strenuous and
painstaking efforts of the authorities of the Foreign
Settlements for the maintenance of peace and order within
their jurisdiction are worthy of the highest praise from
both foreign and Chinese residents. That the Settlements
of Shanghai are to-day free of the "sanguinary atmosphere"
is undoubtedly due to the energetic efforts of the
authorities, but what also deserves commendation is the
spirit of close co-operation with the authorities maintained
by the residents in the Settlements. If this co-operation
had been lacking, then the terroristic activities that
took place half a year ago, such as the discovery of
human heads and arms, the sending of poisonous fruits
and of human arms, etc., would unquestionably have in
some way affected the residents of the Settlements who
would not then have remained so calm as they did, while
the 3½ million Chinese residents in the Foreign Settlements,
who are already overwhelmed with vexation and indignation,
would not have remained so submissive and silent without
resorting to reckless and rash action.

But this peaceful state of affairs is
now over. A doubt has seized upon the minds of the
residents in the International Settlement. They are
asking: "Can the Chinese people live in the International
Settlement any longer? Does law exist in the International
Settlement?" The residents appear to be in an unprecedented
state of panic. Though they are carrying on as
usual, a dark shadow of impending calamity seems to have
overtaken them.

This feeling of terror is not due to
the wave of assassinations and kidnappings, because
murder and kidnapping are not uncommon occurrences. The
Chinese residents realize full well that all perpetrators
of terroristic activities belong to the other party who
always adopts an attitude of antagonism towards those
who are unwilling to co-operate. No Chinese citizen
is afraid of such terrorism because they are confident
that the authorities of the International Settlement
are competent to maintain peace and order within their
jurisdiction and will not allow the continuation of such
terroristic activities, while, on the other hand,
the people fully expect that they would be subjected
to oppression and assassination at the hands of their
enemy. They are only determined to resist; there is no
fear amongst them.

A state of terror now exists amongst
the Chinese people because they are in doubt as to
whether or not the authorities of the International
Settlement are still able to maintain their original
spirit of administering the Settlement according to law.
Originally, the Chinese residents in the International
Settlement would never have entertained any idea that
the authorities of the Settlement to which they have
pledged their support have become powerless to do this,
but they are unable to find an explanation for the
extradition of the "terrorist arrested on July 7" to

1938年8月1日。晨间译稿。

《导报》（评论）7月31日刊：

外侨居留地居民中存在极大焦虑

自去年8月13日战事爆发以来，国际租界中区及西区以及法租界的人口已增加数倍。外侨居留地当局为维持其辖区内的和平与秩序所付出的艰苦卓绝的努力，值得中外居民的高度赞扬。上海租界今日得以免受“血腥氛围”之扰，无疑归功于当局的积极努力，但同样值得称赞的是租界居民与当局保持的紧密合作精神。如果缺乏这种合作，那么半年前发生的恐怖活动，如发现人头和手臂、寄送有毒水果和人臂等，无疑会在某种程度上影响租界居民，使他们无法像当时那样保持冷静；而身处外侨居留地、早已饱受烦恼和愤怒之苦的350万中国居民，如果不采取鲁莽轻率的行动，也不会保持如此顺从和沉默。

但这种和平状态现已结束。一种疑虑笼罩在国际租界居民的心头。他们在问：“中国人还能在国际租界生活下去吗？国际租界还有法律吗？”居民们似乎处于一种前所未有的恐慌状态。虽然他们照常生活，但 impending calamity（迫在眉睫的灾难）的阴影似乎已笼罩在他们身上。

这种恐怖感并非源于暗杀和绑架浪潮，因为谋杀和绑架并非罕见之事。中国居民充分认识到，所有恐怖活动的实施者都属于另一方，该方总是对不愿合作的人采取敌对态度。没有中国公民害怕此类恐怖主义，因为他们相信国际租界当局有能力维持其辖区内的和平与秩序，不会允许此类恐怖活动继续存在；另一方面，民众完全预料到自己会遭受敌人的压迫和暗杀。他们只决心抵抗；其中并无恐惧。

中国人民现在处于恐怖状态，是因为他们怀疑国际租界当局是否仍能维持其依法治理租界的原有精神。原本，国际租界的中国居民绝不会想到，他们所支持拥护的租界当局已无力做到这一点，但他们无法为将“7月7日逮捕的恐怖分子”引渡至

August 1, 1938. Morning Translation.

the Japanese military headquarters.
In the first place, the judicial system
of the International Settlement is based entirely on
the agreements concluded by the Powers concerned and the
Chinese Government. According to the treaties, people
enjoying consular jurisdiction should be handed over
to their respective Consulates. Article 6 of the
Provisional Court Rendition Agreement, which is still in
force, provides that Chinese and foreigners without
consular jurisdiction should be arraigned before the
Special District Court within 24 hours of arrest, and if
they are not sent to Court within 24 hours, they should
be regarded as not guilty and released.
The so-called "July 7 terrorists" were
detained at the Police Station for over ten days without
being sent to the Court; this is not acting in the spirit
of the Court agreement. Now, one of the arrested men,
instead of being released in accordance with the Court
Agreement, has been handed over to the Japanese Army.
This is the first point over which the residents in the
Settlement are entertaining some doubts and fears.
Secondly, the S.M.C. recently promulgated
a set of Emergency Measures. Legally, these Measures
should not be contrary to the terms of the treaties signed
between the Powers and the Chinese Government. Under
extraordinary conditions, some changes may be made according
to circumstances but laws are as effective as Emergency
Measures.
The Emergency Measures provide: "Any
person committing an offence against armed forces in the
International Settlement will be liable to be handed over
to the armed forces concerned." It is said that one of
the "July 7 terrorists" has been extradited to the
Japanese Army under the terms of these Emergency Measures.
According to newspaper reports, all these so-called
terroristic acts were directed against individuals and
not against any armed force; therefore there is no ground
for their extradition to an armed force. This is the
second point over which residents in the International
Settlement express some doubt.
These two points have aroused a feeling
of danger in the minds of the residents. This should
not be allowed to exist or spread. We hope the foreign
ratepayers' meeting, which is the highest power in the
International Settlement, and the Shanghai Municipal
Council, its administrative organ in the Settlement, will
correct this uncertain state of affairs as soon as
possible in order to restore the feeling of security
in the Settlement.
The authorities of the International
Settlement should in the first place, undertake to secure
the return of the so-called "July 7 terrorist" who has
been extradited to the Japanese Army. According to law,
he should be released (for he has been under detention
for more than 24 hours), but under the present extraordinary
situation, he should be arraigned before the Special
District Court for trial. Secondly, the Settlement
authorities should, without delay, charge all the other
persons arrested before the Special District Court.
Only in this way may the residents in
the Settlement regain their confidence in the authorities
of the International Settlement.

1938年8月1日。晨间译稿。

日本军方总部一事找到解释。
首先，国际租界的司法体系完全建立在有关列强与中国政府签订的协定基础之上。根据条约，享有领事裁判权的人应移交给各自的领事馆。目前仍然有效的《特区法院移交章程》第六条规定，无领事裁判权的华人和外国人应在被捕后24小时内被提审至特区法院，如果未在24小时内送交法院，应视为无罪并予以释放。
所谓的“7月7日恐怖分子”在警察局被拘留了十多天而未送交法院；这不符合法院协定的精神。现在，其中一名被捕者非但没有按照法院协定获释，反而被移交给日本军队。这是引起租界居民某些疑虑和恐惧的第一点。
其次，工部局最近颁布了一套紧急措施。从法律上讲，这些措施不应违背列强与中国政府签订的条约条款。在特殊情况下，可以根据情况做出一些变更，但法律效力等同于紧急措施。
紧急措施规定：“任何在国际租界内对武装部队犯罪的人，将被移交给有关的武装部队。”据说，“7月7日恐怖分子”中的一人是根据这些紧急措施的条款被引渡给日本军队的。据报纸报道，所有这些所谓的恐怖行为都是针对个人，而非针对任何武装部队；因此，将他们引渡给武装部队没有依据。这是国际租界居民表示怀疑的第二点。
这两点在居民心中引起了危险感。这种情况不应存在或蔓延。我们希望作为国际租界最高权力机构的纳税人会议，及其在租界的行政机构上海公共租界工部局，能尽快纠正这种不确定状态，以恢复租界内的安全感。
国际租界当局首先应承诺索回已被引渡给日本军队的所谓“7月7日恐怖分子”。根据法律，他本应被释放（因为他已被拘留超过24小时），但在目前的特殊局势下，他应被提审至特区法院受审。其次，租界当局应立即将所有其他被捕人员控告至特区法院。
唯有如此，租界居民才能重新恢复对国际租界当局的信心。
